items.detail: We introduce Zep, a novel memory layer service for AI agents that outperforms the current state-of-the-art system, MemGPT, in the Deep Memory Retrieval (DMR) benchmark. Additionally, Zep excels in more comprehensive and challenging evaluations than DMR that better reflect real-world enterprise use cases. While existing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) frameworks for large language model (LLM)-based agents are limited to static document retrieval, enterprise applications demand dynamic knowledge integration from diverse sources including ongoing conversations and business data. Zep addresses this fundamental limitation through its core component Graphiti -- a temporally-aware knowledge graph engine that dynamically synthesizes both unstructured conversational data and structured business data while maintaining historical relationships. In the DMR benchmark, which the MemGPT team established as their primary evaluation metric, Zep demonstrates superior performance (94.8% vs 93.4%). Beyond DMR, Zep's capabilities are further validated through the more challenging LongMemEval benchmark, which better reflects enterprise use cases through complex temporal reasoning tasks. In this evaluation, Zep achieves substantial results with accuracy improvements of up to 18.5% while simultaneously reducing response latency by 90% compared to baseline implementations. These results are particularly pronounced in enterprise-critical tasks such as cross-session information synthesis and long-term context maintenance, demonstrating Zep's effectiveness for deployment in real-world applications.
items.title_zh: Zep：代理内存的时空知识图架构
items.detail_zh: 我们引入了Zep，这是AI代理的新记忆层服务，在深记忆检索(DMR)基准中，它的表现超过了目前最先进的系统MemGPT。此外，Zep在比DMR更全面和更具挑战性的评价方面表现优异，能够更好地反映现实世界的企业使用案例。虽然基于大语言模型(LLM)的代理商的现有检索-增强生成(RAG)框架仅限于静态文件检索，但企业应用程序需要从不同来源，包括正在进行的对话和业务数据，进行动态知识整合。 Zep通过它的核心成分Graphiti来解决这一根本的局限性——一种时间意识的知识图引擎，在保持历史关系的同时，动态地合成非结构的对话数据和结构化的商业数据。在作为主要评价指标的多指标类集调查小组制定的DMR基准中，Zep显示业绩优异(94.8%对93.4%)。除了DMR，泽普的能力通过更具挑战性的LongMemEval基准进一步验证，通过复杂的时间推理任务更好地反映企业的使用案例。在本次评价中，泽普取得了实质性成果，精度提高高达18.5%，同时与基线实施相比，反应延迟度降低了90%。这些成果在跨会间信息综合和长期上下文维护等企业关键任务中尤为突出，显示出泽普在现实世界应用中的部署效果。

items.detail: Across coding, web, and tool-use tasks, language-model agents are now routinely trained with the same recipe: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to learn the interface, then multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL) to master it. Code-as-policy (CaP) casts robot manipulation in the same form, as the policy writes code against robot APIs and reads back the results, so the same recipe should apply. Yet existing CaP agents sidestep training: they either prompt closed frontier models or delegate manipulation to pre-trained vision-language-action models (VLAs) and high-level skills, while small open vision-language models (VLMs) fail outright. We present CaPtain, an open post-training pipeline that turns a small open VLM into a capable CaP agent, with no VLA, frontier model, or privileged state at test time. CaPtain trains and deploys the policy inside CaPtain-Harness, which exposes low-level perception, geometry, and guarded-motion primitives across simulation and real hardware. We first align the base model via SFT on synthetic trajectories generated with GPT-6 Astra, then apply multi-turn RL. Multi-turn RL must credit tens of agent requests, whose physical effects often surface turns later, from a single end-of-episode outcome. We therefore introduce a physical critic that reads privileged simulator state, never seen by the policy, and credits each request by how much it changes the predicted chance of success. Starting from Qwen3.5-4B (0% zero-shot), CaPtain-4B reaches 55.4% held-out LIBERO success after SFT and 73.8% after RL. On LIBERO-PRO, it reaches 78.5%, surpassing several frontier-model agents, and its RL gains persist across three perturbation suites (+17.6 to +21.2 points). Without target-domain training, it attains 83.3% on SimplerEnv WidowX, exceeds frontier models on CaP-Bench, and runs on a real robot after simulation-only adaptation. We release all code, data, and model weights.
items.title_zh: CaPtain：培训后代码-政策机器人代理的管道
items.detail_zh: 在整个编码、网络和工具使用任务中，语言模型代理人现在都定期接受同样的食谱培训：受监督的微调(SFT)学习界面，然后是多回合强化学习(RL)来掌握界面。代码-as-policy (CaP) 将机器人操控方式设定为同一种形式，因为政策会针对机器人API写出代码并读取结果，所以同样的食谱应该适用。然而，现有的CaP代理商回避培训：他们要么推动封闭的前沿模型，要么授权操纵预先培训的视觉语言行动模型(VLA)和高级技能，而小型开放的视觉语言模型(VLM)则彻底失败。我们介绍CaPtain，一个开放的训练后管道，它把一个小的开放的VLM 变成一个有能力的CaP代理，没有VLA，前沿模型，或特权状态的测试时间。 CaPtain在CaPtain-Harness(英语：CaPtain-Harness)内部进行训练并部署政策，它暴露出低水平的感知，几何，和守护-运动原始人跨越了模拟和真实的硬件。我们首先通过SFT在由GPT-6 Astra所生成的合成轨迹上对准了基础模型，然后应用多回转的RL。多回转的RL必须信用于数十个代理请求，其物理效应往往会从一个单一的终极结果中转出后表面。因此，我们引入了一个物理评论家，阅读特权模拟状态，从来没有被政策看到，从Quen3.5-4B(0%为零发)起，CaPtain-4B在SFT后达到55.4%被搁置的LIBERO成功率，在RL后达到73.8%。在LIBERO-PRO上，它达到了78.5%，超过了几个前沿型特工，它的RL增益在三个扰动套房(+17.6到+21.2分)上持续。没有目标域训练，它在SimmerEnv WiebleX上取得了83.3%的成绩，超过了CaP-Bench上的前沿模型，并在模拟后只进行模拟改造后运行在真正的机器人上。我们发布所有的代码，数据和模型重量。

items.detail: Real-time vision demands models that are accurate, efficient, and simple to deploy across diverse hardware. The YOLO family has become widely deployed for this reason, yet most YOLO detectors still rely on non-maximum suppression at inference, carry heavy detection heads due to Distribution Focal Loss, require long training schedules, and can leave the smallest objects without positive label assignments. We present Ultralytics YOLO26, a unified real-time vision model family that addresses these limitations through coordinated architecture and training advances. YOLO26 uses a dual-head design for native NMS-free end-to-end inference and removes DFL entirely, yielding a lighter head with unconstrained regression range. Its training pipeline combines MuSGD, a hybrid Muon-SGD optimizer adapted from large language model training; Progressive Loss, which shifts supervision toward the inference-time head; and STAL, a label assignment strategy that guarantees positive coverage for small objects. Beyond detection, YOLO26 introduces task-specific head and loss designs for instance segmentation, pose estimation, and oriented detection, producing consistent gains across tasks and scales. The family spans five scales (n/s/m/l/x) and supports detection, instance segmentation, pose estimation, classification, and oriented detection in a single pipeline, with an open-vocabulary extension, YOLOE-26, for text-, visual-, and prompt-free inference. Across all scales, YOLO26 achieves 40.9-57.5 mAP on COCO at 1.7-11.8 ms T4 TensorRT latency, advancing the accuracy-latency Pareto front over prior real-time detectors, while YOLOE-26x reaches 40.6 AP on LVIS minival under text prompting. Code and models are available at https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics.
items.title_zh: 超解YOLO26：统一实时端对端视野模型
items.detail_zh: 实时视觉需要准确，高效，简便的模型，以在各种硬件中部署。 YOLO家族因此被广泛部署，然而大多数YOLO探测器在推论上仍然依赖非最大压制，由于分布焦距损失而携带重探测头，需要较长的训练时间表，可以让最小的物体没有正面的标签任务。我们介绍Ultralytics YOLO26，这是一个统一的实时视野模型家族，通过协调的建筑和培训进步来克服这些局限性。 YOLO26为本土NMS无端对端推论使用双头设计，并完全去除DFL，产生一个没有约束的回归范围的较轻头。其培训管道结合了MuSGD这一混合的Muon-SGD优化器，根据大型语言模式培训加以调整；进步损失，将监督转向推论时间头；和STAL，一种标签分配策略，它保证对小物体的正面覆盖。除检测外，YOLO26还引入了特定任务头和损失设计，例如分解，提出估计和定向检测，在任务和尺度之间产生一致的收益。家族跨越5个尺度(n/s/m/l/x)，支持检测，实例分解，在单一的管道中提出估计，分类，并定向检测，并带有开放式的vocabulary扩展，YOLOE-26，用于文本，视觉，以及即时的免费推断。在所有尺度上，YOLO26在COCO上以1.7至11.8 ms T4 TensorRT的耐久性达到40.9至57.5 mAP，将精度-常帕雷托正面推进到之前的实时探测器上，而YOLOE-26x在文字提示下在LVIS小val上达到40.6 AP。代码和模型见https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics。

items.title: OmniEdu: Open Foundation Models for Learning and Teaching
items.subtitle: Educational foundation models must solve problems, understand curriculum structure, diagnose learner difficulties, and provide appropriate instructional support. Existing educational language models often focus on either problem solving or tutoring, with training mixtures organized by source or task rather than capability. We present OmniEdu, an open family of foundation models for K-12 learning and teaching. items.detail: Educational foundation models must solve problems, understand curriculum structure, diagnose learner difficulties, and provide appropriate instructional support. Existing educational language models often focus on either problem solving or tutoring, with training mixtures organized by source or task rather than capability. We present OmniEdu, an open family of foundation models for K-12 learning and teaching. Its instruction-tuning corpus combines over 100 educational resources and general instruction sources, organized around four capabilities: subject competence, curriculum grounding, diagnostic reasoning, and pedagogical action and scaffolding. Our pipeline integrates deterministic cleaning, semantic auditing and rewriting, task-specific quality scoring, token-budgeted diversity selection, and pedagogical instruction assignment. It yields 69,999 examples and 15.96M supervised response tokens, including 60,951 education-specific examples. We fine-tune 4B, 9B, and 27B models and evaluate curriculum grounding, K-12 problem solving, and pedagogical tutoring, alongside general capability. Education-oriented tuning consistently improves all three educational benchmark groups across model scales. OmniEdu-27B achieves 63.12% EM and 76.69% F1 on K12-Bench, 85.89% on MathFish, 86.95% on EDUMATH, and 78.74% in MathTutorBench's Scaffold setting. It also achieves the highest Teaching average on LongTutor among the evaluated models, at 3.02. These results demonstrate the value of curated, capability-balanced supervision for adapting general language models to educational tasks spanning problem solving, curriculum understanding, and instructional support.
items.title_zh: OmniEdu：开放的学习和教学基础模式
items.detail_zh: 教育基础模式必须解决问题，了解课程结构，诊断学习者的困难，并提供适当的教学支持。现有的教育语言模式往往侧重于解决问题或辅导，培训混合物按来源或任务而不是能力来安排。我们介绍OmniEdu，一个开放的K-12学习和教学的基础模式家庭。其教学调校法将100多家教育资源和一般教学来源结合起来，围绕四个能力组织：学科能力、课程基础、诊断推理、教学行动和脚手架。我们的管道将确定性清洁、语义审计和重写、特定任务的质量评分、象征性预算的多样性选择以及教学指导任务结合起来。它产生了69 999个实例和15 96M监督反应标志，包括60 951个教育特有实例。我们微调4B、9B和27B模式，评估课程基础、K-12问题的解决和教学辅导以及一般能力。以教育为导向的调整不断改善所有三个教育基准组的示范规模。 OmniEdu-27B在K12-Bench上实现63.12%EM和76.69%F1，在MathFish上达到85.89%，在EDUMATH上达到86.95%，在MathTutor Bench的脚手架设置上达到78.74%。它还在被评价的模型中实现了LongTutor教学平均最高，为3.02。这些结果表明，在使通用语言模式适应解决各种问题、理解课程和提供教学支持等教育任务方面，经过管理、能力平衡的监督很有价值。

items.detail: Recent advances in automatic rigging now deliver animation-ready 3D assets at scale, yet generating the motion to drive them remains a bottleneck. Existing learned animators are topology-constrained: they rely on category-specific templates or require per-skeleton fine-tuning and reference motions at inference. We present UniMate, a unified foundation model that synthesizes articulated motion for arbitrary skeletons from a rigged 3D asset and a text prompt, with no test-time optimization or per-skeleton retraining. UniMate introduces a topology-aware diffusion transformer, which integrates skeletal topology into attention via three mechanisms: (1) a graph-aware attention bias from pairwise joint relations and geodesic distances; (2) a spectral rotary position embedding generalizing RoPE to arbitrary kinematic trees via the graph Laplacian; and (3) a global topological conditioner attention-pooled from the rest-pose skeleton. We also curate UniML3D, 13,006 motion sequences spanning bipedal, quadrupedal, avian, marine, insectoid, serpentine, and articulated rigid objects with unified canonicalization and text pairing. Trained on this dataset, UniMate outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in quality, generalization, and efficiency, and supports zero-shot cross-topology transfer, in-betweening, expansion, and text-guided editing. Our project page is available at https://linzhanmou.com/unimate/.
items.title_zh: UniMate：将千变万化的 Skeletons 动画统一模型
items.detail_zh: 近期在自动操纵方面的进步现在可以大规模地提供动画准备的3D资产，但驱动这些资产的运动仍然是一个瓶颈。现有学习的动画师在地形学上是受制约的：他们依赖特定类别的模板，或者要求每斯凯莱顿在推论时进行微调和参考运动。我们提出UniMate，一个统一的基础模型，它从一个被操纵的3D资产和文本提示器中合成任意骨架的清晰运动，没有测试时间优化或每斯凯莱顿再培训。 UniMate引入了一种地形感知扩散变压器，通过三种机制将骨骼感知融合到注意力中：(1)对偶联关系和大地测量距离的图感知注意力偏差；(2)通过图Laplacian嵌入RoPE的光谱回转位置，将RoPE通化到任意运动树上；(3)从休眠骨架上汇集全球地形感知器注意力。我们还管理UniML3D、13 006个运动序列，这些序列跨越两面体、四面体、禽类、海洋、昆虫、蛇形动物和具有统一条形化和文本配对的刚性物体。受此数据集训练，UniMate在质量，通俗化，效率方面超越了最先进的基线，支持零镜头跨地形传输，介于间隙，扩展，以及文本引导编辑。我们的项目网页见https://linzhanmou.com/unimate/。

items.detail: People have long dreamed of an assistant that is always there to guide them and remind what they forget, from new dishes to lost keys. Powered by multimodal large language models (MLLMs), egocentric AI assistants on wearable devices are bringing this dream within reach: they see what the user sees and give instructions for user's physical work when necessary. However, testing such assistance is challenging and usually requires real people. The expensive and rare real interaction data leaves a key question unanswered: Can today's MLLMs truly help people in physical world? To answer this question, we propose InteractiveWorld, the first verifiable environment for closed-loop interaction between human and AI assistant. Unlike existing robot-centric simulators, InteractiveWorld lets the assistant guide a human agent who observes the scene, understands instructions, and acts independently. It thus realistically simulates how AI assistant collaborates with human: the assistant instructs, the human acts, and the environment executes actions and updates what they see next. Building on it, we introduce InteractiveBench, the first dynamic benchmark for egocentric AI assistants, with 120 multi-turn tasks across six categories. In each task, the assistant guides the human in real time, and every instruction shapes the outcome, which is scored by verifiable, state-based rewards. Experiments with 12 frontier MLLMs show they are still far from reliable assistants. Even the strongest model, Claude Fable 5.1, achieves at most 20% and 25% on long-horizon Guidance and Planning tasks, respectively. Overall, our work offers a verifiable platform and a rigorous evaluation set, laying a solid foundation for research on interactive MLLM assistants that truly help people in the physical world.
items.title_zh: 互动世界：可验证的人类-儿童环境，以构建更好的互动 MLLM 助理
items.detail_zh: 人们早就梦想有一个助手 指导他们 并提醒他们忘记的东西 从新的菜肴到丢失的钥匙 在多模式大型语言模型(MLLMs)的推动下，可穿戴设备上以自我为中心的AI助手正在使这个梦想伸手：他们看到用户所看到的，并在必要时为用户的身体工作提供指示。然而，测试此类援助具有挑战性，通常需要真正的人。昂贵而稀有的真正互动数据留下了一个关键问题：今天的MLLM能真正帮助实际世界的人吗？为了回答这个问题，我们提出"互动世界"(InteractiveWorld)，这是人类和AI助手之间闭路互动的第一个可核查的环境。与现有的以机器人为中心的模拟器不同，"互动世界"让助理指导一个观察场景，理解指令，独立行动的人类代理。因此，它现实地模拟了AI助理如何与人类合作：助理指导，人类行为，环境执行行动，更新他们接下来看到的。在此基础上，我们引入了"互动奔驰"(Interactive Bench)，这是以自我为中心的AI助手的第一个动态基准，共有120个多回合任务，分为6个类别。在每个任务中，助理实时指导人，每个指令都塑造结果，通过可核查的，基于国家的奖励来打分。 12个前沿的MLLMs的实验显示，它们仍然远远没有可靠的助手。即使是最强的模型克洛德Fable 5.1，在长视线指导和规划任务上分别达到最多20%和25%。总体而言，我们的工作提供了一个可核查的平台和一个严格的评价集，为研究真正帮助实际世界人民的交互式MLLM助手奠定了坚实的基础。

items.detail: As large language models advance, AI agents are moving beyond isolated, domain-specific tasks toward long-horizon, cross-domain workflows. This transition exposes two challenges: increasing harness complexity makes manual design difficult to scale, while tighter coupling to specific domains limits the generality of a single harness. The central question thus shifts from how to engineer a stronger harness for one domain to how to autonomously construct specialized harnesses, improve them through experience, and orchestrate them across domains. We introduce Raven, The Harness of Harnesses, an open-source multi-agent ecosystem that automatically constructs and evolves modular harnesses for specific models and domains, treating each executable model--harness pair as a composable unit of intelligence. To support an All-Domain Collaboration Network, its Host Agent decomposes goals, matches subtasks to specialized agents, coordinates execution dependencies, and integrates results, while a host archive and EverOS preserve experience across tasks and Skill Forge makes that experience available as reusable procedures. Our theory establishes sufficient conditions for such composition to expand reliable task coverage beyond that of the available individual agents under a shared resource budget. On complex and long-horizon tasks, Raven significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art agent systems, pushing the frontier of composable agentic intelligence.
items.title_zh: Raven：利用哈内斯为可编译的代理智能
items.detail_zh: 随着大型语言模型的推进，AI代理正在超越孤立的，专有域的任务，转向长视野，跨域工作流程。这一过渡暴露了两个挑战：日益复杂的利用使得人工设计难以规模化，而与具体领域的更紧密的结合限制了单一的利用的通用性。因此，中心问题从如何为一个领域设计更强大的工具转向如何自主地建造专门工具，通过经验改进这些工具，并在各个领域加以协调。我们引入了Raven， The Harnesses，一个开源的多剂生态系统，它自动构建和演化特定模型和域的模块化带，将每个可执行的模型-harness配对作为可调和的智能单元。为了支持一个全域协作网络，其主机代理会分解目标，将子任务匹配到专门代理，协调执行依赖，并整合结果，而主机档案和EverOS则保存跨任务的经验，Skill Forge使该经验成为可重复使用的程序。我们的理论为这种构成提供了充分的条件，以扩大可靠的任务范围，使其超出共享资源预算下现有个别代理人的任务范围。在复杂而长的视野任务上，雷文显著地超越了最先进的特工系统，推动了可复合的特工智能的前沿。

items.detail: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a fundamental paradigm for expanding Large Language Models beyond their static training limitations. However, a critical misalignment exists between current RAG capabilities and real-world information environments. Modern knowledge repositories are inherently multimodal, containing rich combinations of textual content, visual elements, structured tables, and mathematical expressions. Yet existing RAG frameworks are limited to textual content, creating fundamental gaps when processing multimodal documents. We present RAG-Anything, a unified framework that enables comprehensive knowledge retrieval across all modalities. Our approach reconceptualizes multimodal content as interconnected knowledge entities rather than isolated data types. The framework introduces dual-graph construction to capture both cross-modal relationships and textual semantics within a unified representation. We develop cross-modal hybrid retrieval that combines structural knowledge navigation with semantic matching. This enables effective reasoning over heterogeneous content where relevant evidence spans multiple modalities. RAG-Anything demonstrates superior performance on challenging multimodal benchmarks, achieving significant improvements over state-of-the-art methods. Performance gains become particularly pronounced on long documents where traditional approaches fail. Our framework establishes a new paradigm for multimodal knowledge access, eliminating the architectural fragmentation that constrains current systems. Our framework is open-sourced at: https://github.com/HKUDS/RAG-Anything.
items.title_zh: RAG-任何东西：全方位RAG框架
items.detail_zh: 检索增强型一代(RAG)已成为超越其静态训练局限性扩展大语言模型的基本范例。然而，目前的RAG能力和现实世界信息环境之间存在严重的错位。现代知识库内在是多模式的，包含丰富的文本内容组合，视觉元素，结构化的表格和数学表达。然而，现有的RAG框架仅限于文字内容，在处理多式联运文件时造成了根本的空白。我们提出 " 任何事情 " (RAG-Anything)，这是一个统一的框架，能够对所有模式进行全面的知识检索。我们的方法将多式联运内容重新定义为相互关联的知识实体，而不是孤立的数据类型。该框架引入了双图构思，以在统一代表制内既体现跨模式关系，又体现文字语义。我们开发了跨模式混合检索，将结构知识导航与语义匹配相结合。在相关证据涉及多种模式的情况下，这样就能够有效地对不同内容进行推理。 RAG-任何东西都显示出在挑战多式联运基准方面的优异表现，比最先进的方法有了重大的改进。在传统方法失败的长期文件中，业绩收益尤其明显。我们的框架为获得多式联运知识确立了新的范式，消除了制约现有系统的建筑不成体系。我们的框架开放来源于：https://github.com/HKUDS/RAG-Anything。

items.detail: Recently, large language model (LLM) based text-to-speech (TTS) systems have gradually become the mainstream in the industry due to their high naturalness and powerful zero-shot voice cloning capabilities.Here, we introduce the IndexTTS system, which is mainly based on the XTTS and Tortoise model. We add some novel improvements. Specifically, in Chinese scenarios, we adopt a hybrid modeling method that combines characters and pinyin, making the pronunciations of polyphonic characters and long-tail characters controllable. We also performed a comparative analysis of the Vector Quantization (VQ) with Finite-Scalar Quantization (FSQ) for codebook utilization of acoustic speech tokens. To further enhance the effect and stability of voice cloning, we introduce a conformer-based speech conditional encoder and replace the speechcode decoder with BigVGAN2. Compared with XTTS, it has achieved significant improvements in naturalness, content consistency, and zero-shot voice cloning. As for the popular TTS systems in the open-source, such as Fish-Speech, CosyVoice2, FireRedTTS and F5-TTS, IndexTTS has a relatively simple training process, more controllable usage, and faster inference speed. Moreover, its performance surpasses that of these systems. Our demos are available at https://index-tts.github.io.
items.title_zh: IndexTTS：工业一级可控和高效的零热文本对语音系统
items.detail_zh: 最近，基于文字对语音(TTS)的大型语言模型(LLM)系统由于具有较高的自然性和强大的零镜头语音克隆能力，逐渐成为业界的主流。在这里，我们引入了IndexTTS系统，该系统主要基于XTTS和龟模型。我们补充了一些新的改进。具体来说，在汉语情景中，我们采用混合模型方法，将字符和pinyin结合，使多音字符和长尾字符的发音可以控制。我们还与Finite-Scalar Quantization(FSQ)对矢量量量化(VQ)进行了比较分析，用于编码本使用声学语音符号。为了进一步提高语音克隆的效果和稳定性，我们引入了以听素为基础的语音条件编码器，并将语音码解码器替换为BigVGAN2。与XTTS相比，在自然性，内容一致性，以及零镜头语音克隆方面都取得了显著的改善。至于开源软件中流行的TTS系统，如Fish-Speech，CosyVoice2，FireRedTTS和F5-TTS，IndexTTS的训练过程相对简单，使用率比较可控，推论速度更快。此外，其业绩超过了这些系统。我们的演示可在https://index-ts.github.io上查阅。

items.detail: This paper presents Youtu-Parsing, an efficient and versatile document parsing model designed for high-performance content extraction. The architecture employs a native Vision Transformer (ViT) featuring a dynamic-resolution visual encoder to extract shared document features, coupled with a prompt-guided Youtu-LLM-2B language model for layout analysis and region-prompted decoding. Leveraging this decoupled and feature-reusable framework, we introduce a high-parallelism decoding strategy comprising two core components: token parallelism and query parallelism. The token parallelism strategy concurrently generates up to 64 candidate tokens per inference step, which are subsequently validated through a verification mechanism. This approach yields a 5--11x speedup over traditional autoregressive decoding and is particularly well-suited for highly structured scenarios, such as table recognition. To further exploit the advantages of region-prompted decoding, the query parallelism strategy enables simultaneous content prediction for multiple bounding boxes (up to five), providing an additional 2x acceleration while maintaining output quality equivalent to standard decoding. Youtu-Parsing encompasses a diverse range of document elements, including text, formulas, tables, charts, seals, and hierarchical structures. Furthermore, the model exhibits strong robustness when handling rare characters, multilingual text, and handwritten content. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that Youtu-Parsing achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on both the OmniDocBench and olmOCR-bench benchmarks. Overall, Youtu-Parsing demonstrates significant experimental value and practical utility for large-scale document intelligence applications.
items.title_zh: Youtu-Parersing：通过高保拉利主义解码来认识、构建和识别
items.detail_zh: 本文介绍Youtu-Parsing，这是为高性能内容提取设计的高效多功能文档解析模型。该架构采用了以动态分辨率可视编码器为特色的本土视觉变形器(ViT)来取出共享的文档特性，并配有可被迅速引导的Youtu-LLM-2B语言模型来进行布局分析并进行区域催化解码。我们利用这个脱钩和可重复特性的框架，引入了由两个核心部分组成的高平行性解码战略：符号并行主义和查询并行主义。象征性平行战略同时产生最多64个候选的推断步骤，随后通过核查机制加以验证。这种方法产生5-11x比传统的自旋解码更快的速度，特别适合高度结构化的情景，如表识别。为了进一步发挥区域即时解码的优势，查询并行策略可以同时对多边框(最多为5个)进行内容预测，在保持输出质量等同标准解码的同时，提供额外2x加速。 Youtu-Parsing 包含多种文档元素，包括文本、公式、表格、图表、封条和分级结构。此外，该模型在处理稀有字符、多语种文本和手写内容时表现出了强烈的稳健性。广泛的评价表明，Youtu-Parsing在OmniDoc Bench和olmOCR-bench基准上都取得了最新业绩。总体而言，Youtu-Parsing在大规模文件智能应用中显示出重要的实验价值和实际效用。

items.detail: Can LLM agents carry a hard real-world problem from raw data to a system that holds its own against people? We study this in Hearthstone Battlegrounds, an eight-player auto-battler with stochastic shops and battles, hidden information and nearly a thousand interacting cards. We present AutoTavern, a self-improving research system: specialised LLM research agents share a typed research memory, every claim passes verification gates, and live games close the loop, so the agents improve the simulator, opponents and policy and, from the same feedback, their own research process; a human sets goals and rules on ambiguous mechanics. In 20 days AutoTavern built TavernGym, the first faithful, full-content reproduction of the live game, and delivered 23 versions of TavernAgent, trained with PPO against opponents calibrated to real games. TavernAgent plays complete games on the live ladder by itself: its rating rose from 6,000 to about 15,000 and, on the public leaderboard's measure, its last 20 records average a placement of 1.60 with 80% first places, better than the server's ten highest-rated players on every statistic (2.34, 59%). TavernBench, 960 tasks in 40 scenarios, shows that the system the agents built is the strongest player: TavernAgent answers 91% of the play tasks against at most 63% for frontier LLMs, and decides in 0.03 s where they need up to 26 s; within the second a live turn allows, it keeps 90% and no LLM more than 26%. LLM agents build far better than they play. We will open-source TavernBench and TavernGym at https://github.com/MCG-NJU/AutoTavern.
items.detail_zh: LLM特工能携带一个从原始数据到拥有自己对抗人的系统的艰难现实世界问题吗？我们在赫斯通战场上研究这个，一个8个玩家自动击球手，拥有有花样的商店和战斗，隐藏的信息和近千张互动卡片。我们介绍AutoTavern，一个自我改进的研究系统：专门的LLM研究代理共享一个打入式的研究内存，每个索赔通过验证闸门，并且现场游戏关闭循环，因此代理商改进了模拟器，反对者和政策，并从同样的反馈中改进了自己的研究过程；一个关于模棱两可的力学的人类目标和规则。在20天的时间里，AutoTavern建造了TavernGym，这是首个忠实，内容齐全的活游戏复制，并交付了23个版本的TavernAgent，与PPO一起训练了对手被校正为真实游戏。 TavernAgent在直播阶梯上独自出演完整的游戏：其评分从6000分上升到了约15000分，在公共领跑板的衡量下，其最后20个记录平均投放1.60分，排名前80%，优于服务器在每个统计中评分最高的10名玩家(2.34分，59%)。 Tavern Bench，40种情景中的960个任务，显示代理构建的系统是最强的玩家：TavernAgent最多63%的游戏任务回答边疆LLM，并在0.03 s中决定他们需要最多26 s；在第二起直播回合允许的情况下，它保持了90%，没有超过26%的LLM。 LLM的代理 建设远比他们玩。我们将在https://github.com/MCG-NJU/AutoTavern上开放源码的"百花百货"和"百花百货"。

items.detail: Language models are sequential processors, but long-horizon agency requires external information and computation beyond model weights and active context. Prime Agent is an open-source harness for long-horizon evaluation and coding-agent workflows. A persistent IPython REPL follows the Recursive Language Model abstraction for programmatic context processing and test-time compute, while Continual Harness preserves histories, memories, skills, prompts, and subagent specifications across trajectories. Recursive subagents coordinate through direct agent-to-agent communication, and the Agents View lets humans inspect and manage daemon-backed sessions. Prime Agent standardizes execution, recovery, verification, and resource accounting while leaving strategy construction to the model. This low-friction, expressive membrane prevents harness failures from becoming model failures and pushes measurement toward the model's true maximal underlying capability. Prime Agent raises ARC-AGI-3 RHAE Best@1 from 30% to 95.5% and matches or exceeds native and popular harnesses across long-context coding, GPU-kernel generation, emulator construction, and autonomous nanoGPT speedruns. On Factorio, we find refinement allows for continuous technology progression and dedicated subagents enable parallelized work. Code is available at https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent.
items.title_zh: 主干员：自我改进的RLM技巧
items.detail_zh: 语言模型是顺序处理器，但长视距机构需要外部信息以及超出模型权重和活性背景的计算。 Prime Agent是用于长视评价和编码代理工作流程的开源控制器。持续的IPython REPL遵循Recursive Language Model抽象，用于程序上下文处理和测试时间计算，而Continual Harness则保存历史，记忆，技能，提示，以及跨轨迹的亚剂规格。递归亚剂通过直接的代理对代理通信进行协调，代理视图让人类检查和管理守护进程支持的会话。主干员将执行、恢复、核查和资源核算标准化，同时将战略构建留给模型。这种低温，显性薄膜防止了操纵故障成为模型故障，并将测量推向模型真正的最大基础能力。 Prime Agent将ARC-AGI-3 RHAE Best@1从30%提升到95.5%，并匹配或超过本地和流行的拉带，跨越长文本编码，GPU-内核生成，模拟构建，以及自主的纳米GPT增速运行。关于Infantio，我们发现改进可以使技术不断进步，而专用的子剂可以使工作并行。代码见https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent。

items.title: SkillOpt: Executive Strategy for Self-Evolving Agent Skills
items.subtitle: Agent skills today are hand-crafted, generated one-shot, or evolved through loosely controlled self-revision, none of which behaves like a deep-learning optimizer for the skill, and none of which reliably improves over its starting point under feedback. We argue the skill should instead be trained as the external state of a frozen agent, with the same discipline that makes weight-space optimization reproducible. items.detail: Agent skills today are hand-crafted, generated one-shot, or evolved through loosely controlled self-revision, none of which behaves like a deep-learning optimizer for the skill, and none of which reliably improves over its starting point under feedback. We argue the skill should instead be trained as the external state of a frozen agent, with the same discipline that makes weight-space optimization reproducible. SkillOpt is, to our knowledge, the first systematic controllable text-space optimizer for agent skills: a separate optimizer model turns scored rollouts into bounded add/delete/replace edits on a single skill document, and an edit is accepted only when it strictly improves a held-out validation score. A textual learning-rate budget, rejected-edit buffer, and epoch-wise slow/meta update make skill training stable while adding zero inference-time model calls at deployment. Across six benchmarks, seven target models, and three execution harnesses (direct chat, Codex, Claude Code), SkillOpt is best or tied on all 52 evaluated (model, benchmark, harness) cells and beats every per-cell competitor among human, one-shot LLM, Trace2Skill, TextGrad, GEPA, and EvoSkill skills. On GPT-5.5 it lifts the average no-skill accuracy by +23.5 points in direct chat, by +24.8 inside the Codex agentic loop, and by +19.1 inside Claude Code. Transfer experiments further show that optimized skill artifacts retain value when moved across model scales, between Codex and Claude Code execution environments, and to a nearby math benchmark without further optimization.
items.title_zh: SkillOpt：自我发展代理技能执行战略
items.detail_zh: 今天的代理技能是手工制作的，产生一弹一弹，或者通过松散控制的自译自审来演化，其中没有任何一种表现得像技能的深层学习优化器，没有任何一种在反馈下可靠地改善了它的起点。我们主张技能应该作为冷冻剂的外部状态来训练，具有同样的学科，使得重量空间优化可以再生产。据我们所知，SkillOpt是代理技能的首个系统可控文本空间优化器：一个单独的优化器模型将打分的推出转换成在单一技能文档上绑定的添加/删除/替换编辑，只有在严格改进被搁置的验证分数时才接受编辑。文本学习率预算、拒绝编辑缓冲和划时代的慢/元更新使技能培训稳定，同时在部署时增加零推断时间模型呼叫。在6个基准、7个目标模型和3个执行工具(直接聊天、Codex、Claude Code)中，SkillOpt是最佳的或与所有52个被评价的细胞(模型、基准、带)捆绑在一起的，并击败了人类中每个细胞的每个竞争者、一击LM、Trace2Skill、TextGrad、GEPA和EvoSkill技能。在GPT-5.5上，它通过直接聊天的+23.5分，Codex代理循环的+24.8分和Claude代码的+19.1分提高平均无技能精度。转移实验进一步显示，优化的技能文物在跨模型尺度移动时，在Codex和Claude代码执行环境之间，以及在不进一步优化的情况下，保留到附近的数学基准上的价值。

items.detail: Recent advancements in 3D generative modeling have significantly improved the generation realism, yet the field is still hampered by existing representations, which struggle to capture assets with complex topologies and detailed appearance. This paper present an approach for learning a structured latent representation from native 3D data to address this challenge. At its core is a new sparse voxel structure called O-Voxel, an omni-voxel representation that encodes both geometry and appearance. O-Voxel can robustly model arbitrary topology, including open, non-manifold, and fully-enclosed surfaces, while capturing comprehensive surface attributes beyond texture color, such as physically-based rendering parameters. Based on O-Voxel, we design a Sparse Compression VAE which provides a high spatial compression rate and a compact latent space. We train large-scale flow-matching models comprising 4B parameters for 3D generation using diverse public 3D asset datasets. Despite their scale, inference remains highly efficient. Meanwhile, the geometry and material quality of our generated assets far exceed those of existing models. We believe our approach offers a significant advancement in 3D generative modeling.
items.title_zh: 3D 世代的本地和契约结构的后人
items.detail_zh: 最近在3D基因模型化方面的进步大大改进了生成现实主义，然而这个领域仍然受到现有表述的阻碍，这些表述试图用复杂的地形和详细的外观来捕捉资产。本文件介绍了从本地立体数据中学习结构化潜在代表性以应对这一挑战的方法。其核心是一种新的稀疏的阴道结构，称为O-Voxel，是一种omni-voxel代表，它同时编码几何和外观。 O-Voxel可以强力地模拟任意地形，包括开放的，非狂形的，和完全封闭的表面，同时捕捉到超出纹理颜色的全面表面属性，如物理渲染参数。基于O-Voxel，我们设计了Sparse Compression VAE，提供高空间压缩率和紧凑的潜伏空间。我们利用不同的公共三维资产数据集，为三维生成培训由4B参数组成的大规模流量匹配模型。尽管其规模很大，但推断仍然非常有效。与此同时，我们创造的资产的几何和物质质量远远超过现有模型。我们认为，我们的做法在三维基因模型的制作方面取得重大进展。

items.detail: Video generation is shifting from end-to-end synthesis toward agentic generation, where planning, tool use, and feedback enable coherent, controllable multi-shot videos. In parallel, video world models provide action-conditioned observations and predicted futures, serving as interactive environments for agents. We study their intersection through the agent harness: an executable runtime that constructs context, exposes tools, maintains state, routes feedback, and manages budgets around video models. This report examines three directions. First, agentic video generation, where harnesses coordinate scripting, shot planning, asset management, production, and editing, alongside the evaluation challenges of these systems. Second, agentic world modeling, where harnesses mediate observation, control, execution, and state. We discuss hybrid designs in which game engines or agent-written programs maintain world state while video models render observations, and how agents and world models can mutually evaluate and improve one another. Third, recursive self-improvement (RSI) in video model development, distinguishing output revisions, updates to harness state, generator parameters, and evaluators, and changes to the improvement procedure itself. We identify how these improvements feed back into subsequent development. Across these directions, we analyze essential agent capabilities, including audiovisual perception, long-horizon planning, memory, code-based interaction, feedback-guided control, skill reuse, and multi-agent coordination. We conclude with challenges in autonomous video production, lifelong memory, programmable hybrid control, autonomous model development, provenance, cost accounting, and evaluation linking video quality and task performance to sustained improvements in models and harnesses.
items.title_zh: 视频生成满足代理哈内斯：代理视频生成，代理世界建模和回溯自我改进
items.detail_zh: 视频生成正在从端到端的合成转向代理生成，其中规划，工具使用和反馈可以实现连贯，可控制的多镜头视频。与此同时，视频世界模型提供有行动条件的观测和预测未来，作为代理商的互动环境。我们通过代理工具来研究它们的相交点：一个可执行的运行时间，构建上下文，曝光工具，保持状态，路径反馈，并管理围绕视频模型的预算。本报告审查了三个方向。首先，制作代理视频，在这些系统中协调脚本、拍摄规划、资产管理、制作和编辑，同时应对这些系统的评价挑战。第二，代理世界建模，利用调解观测、控制、执行和状态。我们讨论了游戏引擎或代理写作程序在视频模型提供观测时维持世界状态的混合设计，以及代理和世界模型如何相互评价和改进。第三，视频模型开发中的递归自改进(RSI)，区分出输出修改，更新来利用状态，生成参数，以及评价者，以及改进程序本身的变化。我们确定这些改进如何反馈到以后的发展之中。在这些方向上，我们分析必要的代理能力，包括视听感知、长视距规划、记忆、基于代码的互动、反馈指导控制、技能再利用和多代理协调。最后，我们在自主视频制作、终身记忆、可编程混合控制、自主模式开发、出处、成本核算和评价方面面临挑战，将视频质量和任务业绩与持续改进模式和利用联系起来。

items.detail: Recent text-to-video diffusion models can generate compelling video sequences, yet they remain silent -- missing the semantic, emotional, and atmospheric cues that audio provides. We introduce LTX-2, an open-source foundational model capable of generating high-quality, temporally synchronized audiovisual content in a unified manner. LTX-2 consists of an asymmetric dual-stream transformer with a 14B-parameter video stream and a 5B-parameter audio stream, coupled through bidirectional audio-video cross-attention layers with temporal positional embeddings and cross-modality AdaLN for shared timestep conditioning. This architecture enables efficient training and inference of a unified audiovisual model while allocating more capacity for video generation than audio generation. We employ a multilingual text encoder for broader prompt understanding and introduce a modality-aware classifier-free guidance (modality-CFG) mechanism for improved audiovisual alignment and controllability. Beyond generating speech, LTX-2 produces rich, coherent audio tracks that follow the characters, environment, style, and emotion of each scene -- complete with natural background and foley elements. In our evaluations, the model achieves state-of-the-art audiovisual quality and prompt adherence among open-source systems, while delivering results comparable to proprietary models at a fraction of their computational cost and inference time. All model weights and code are publicly released.
items.title_zh: LTX-2：高效联合视听基础模型
items.detail_zh: 最近的文字到视频传播模型可以产生令人信服的视频序列，然而它们却保持沉默——缺少音频提供的语义，情感和大气提示。我们采用LTX-2，是一种开源基础模型，能够以统一的方式生成高质量，时间同步的视听内容。 LTX-2由非对称双流变压器组成，具有14B参数的视频流和5B参数的音频流，通过双向音频-视频交叉透视层结合而成，具有时间定位嵌入和跨模式的AdaLN用于共享时序调节。这种结构能够有效培训和推论统一的视听模式，同时分配比音频生成更多的视频生成能力。我们使用多语种文本编码器，以便迅速获得更广泛的理解，并采用一种无模式识别的分类器指导(模式-CFG)机制，以改进视听协调和可控性。 LTX-2除了生成语音外，还产生丰富，连贯的音频音轨，跟踪每个场景的人物，环境，风格和情感——完整地带有自然背景和foley元素。在我们的评价中，该模式实现了最先进的视听质量，并使开源系统迅速遵守，同时以占其计算成本和推断时间的一小部分，提供与专有模式可比的成果。所有模型重量和代码都公开发布。

items.title: Internal Safety Collapse in Frontier Large Language Models

items.detail: This work identifies a critical failure mode in frontier large language models (LLMs), which we term Internal Safety Collapse (ISC): under certain task conditions, models enter a state in which they continuously generate harmful content while executing otherwise benign tasks. We introduce TVD (Task, Validator, Data), a framework that triggers ISC through domain tasks where generating harmful content is the only valid completion, and construct ISC-Bench containing 53 scenarios across 8 professional disciplines. Evaluated on JailbreakBench, three representative scenarios yield worst-case safety failure rates averaging 95.3% across four frontier LLMs (including GPT-5.2 and Claude Sonnet 4.5), substantially exceeding standard jailbreak attacks. Frontier models are more vulnerable than earlier LLMs: the very capabilities that enable complex task execution become liabilities when tasks intrinsically involve harmful content. This reveals a growing attack surface: almost every professional domain uses tools that process sensitive data, and each new dual-use tool automatically expands this vulnerability--even without any deliberate attack. Despite substantial alignment efforts, frontier LLMs retain inherently unsafe internal capabilities: alignment reshapes observable outputs but does not eliminate the underlying risk profile. These findings underscore the need for caution when deploying LLMs in high-stakes settings. Source code: https://github.com/wuyoscar/ISC-Bench
items.title_zh: 边境大语言模型的内部安全碰撞
items.detail_zh: 这项工作确定了前沿大语言模型(LLMs)中的关键故障模式，我们称之为内部安全碰撞(ISC)：在某些任务条件下，模型进入一种状态，在持续生成有害内容的同时执行本来是良性的任务。我们引入了TVD(任务、验证器、数据)，这个框架通过域任务触发ISC，产生有害内容是唯一有效的完成，并构建了ISC-Bench，包含8个专业学科的53种情景。三种具有代表性的情景在四个边境有限责任公司(包括GPT-5.2和Claude Sonnet 4.5)中平均得出95.3%，大大超过标准的越狱袭击。边疆模式比早先的有限责任公司更为脆弱：当任务本质上涉及有害内容时，使复杂任务得以执行的能力就成为责任。这揭示出攻击面越来越大：几乎每个专业领域都使用处理敏感数据的工具，每个新的双重用途工具都自动扩大这种脆弱性——即使没有故意攻击。尽管做出了大量调整努力，但前沿有限责任管理保留了固有的不安全内部能力：调整重塑了可观察到的产出，但并没有消除基本的风险状况。这些调查结果突出表明，在高调环境中部署法学硕士课程时必须谨慎。资料来源：https://github.com/wuyoscar/ISC-Bench。

items.detail: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems enhance large language models (LLMs) by integrating external knowledge sources, enabling more accurate and contextually relevant responses tailored to user needs. However, existing RAG systems have significant limitations, including reliance on flat data representations and inadequate contextual awareness, which can lead to fragmented answers that fail to capture complex inter-dependencies. To address these challenges, we propose LightRAG, which incorporates graph structures into text indexing and retrieval processes. This innovative framework employs a dual-level retrieval system that enhances comprehensive information retrieval from both low-level and high-level knowledge discovery. Additionally, the integration of graph structures with vector representations facilitates efficient retrieval of related entities and their relationships, significantly improving response times while maintaining contextual relevance. This capability is further enhanced by an incremental update algorithm that ensures the timely integration of new data, allowing the system to remain effective and responsive in rapidly changing data environments. Extensive experimental validation demonstrates considerable improvements in retrieval accuracy and efficiency compared to existing approaches. We have made our LightRAG open-source and available at the link: https://github.com/HKUDS/LightRAG.
items.title_zh: LightRAG：简单且快速的检索增强生成
items.detail_zh: 检索增强生成(RAG)系统通过整合外部知识来源来增强大型语言模型(LLMS)，从而能够根据用户需求做出更加准确和符合具体情况的反应。然而，现有的RAG系统有重大的局限性，包括依赖统一的数据表示和缺乏对背景的认识，这可能导致答案分散，无法反映复杂的相互依存关系。为了应对这些挑战，我们提议使用LightRAG，将图表结构纳入文本索引和检索过程。这一创新框架采用双层检索系统，加强从低层和高级知识发现中的全面信息检索。此外，将图表结构与矢量表示法结合起来，有助于高效检索相关实体及其关系，大大改善反应时间，同时保持关联性。这一能力通过递增更新算法得到进一步加强，该算法确保了新数据的及时整合，使该系统能够在迅速变化的数据环境中保持效力和反应能力。与现有方法相比，广泛的实验验证表明，检索的准确性和效率有相当大的提高。我们开放了我们的LightRAG的源代码，可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/HKUDS/LightRAG。

items.title: Qwen3-TTS Technical Report
items.subtitle: In this report, we present the Qwen3-TTS series, a family of advanced multilingual, controllable, robust, and streaming text-to-speech models. Qwen3-TTS supports state-of-the-art 3-second voice cloning and description-based control, allowing both the creation of entirely novel voices and fine-grained manipulation over the output speech. items.detail: In this report, we present the Qwen3-TTS series, a family of advanced multilingual, controllable, robust, and streaming text-to-speech models. Qwen3-TTS supports state-of-the-art 3-second voice cloning and description-based control, allowing both the creation of entirely novel voices and fine-grained manipulation over the output speech. Trained on over 5 million hours of speech data spanning 10 languages, Qwen3-TTS adopts a dual-track LM architecture for real-time synthesis, coupled with two speech tokenizers: 1) Qwen-TTS-Tokenizer-25Hz is a single-codebook codec emphasizing semantic content, which offers seamlessly integration with Qwen-Audio and enables streaming waveform reconstruction via a block-wise DiT. 2) Qwen-TTS-Tokenizer-12Hz achieves extreme bitrate reduction and ultra-low-latency streaming, enabling immediate first-packet emission (97,ms) through its 12.5 Hz, 16-layer multi-codebook design and a lightweight causal ConvNet. Extensive experiments indicate state-of-the-art performance across diverse objective and subjective benchmark (e.g., TTS multilingual test set, InstructTTSEval, and our long speech test set). To facilitate community research and development, we release both tokenizers and models under the Apache 2.0 license.
items.title_zh: Qune3-TTS 技术报告
items.detail_zh: 在本报告中，我们介绍了Qune3-TTS系列，这是一个由先进的多语种，可控，强健，流畅的文本对语音模型组成的家族。 Qune3-TTS支持最先进的3秒语音克隆和基于描述的控制，既允许创造全新的声音，也允许精细地操纵输出语音。 Qune3-TTS对跨越10种语言的500多万小时的语音数据进行了培训，采用双轨LM架构进行实时合成，并配有两种语音示意器： 1) Qun-TTS-Tokenizer-25Hz是一个强调语义内容的单码簿编码器，它提供与Qun-Audio的无缝集成，并通过区块化的DiT.2实现流波形重建 2) Qun-TTS-Tokenizer-12Hz实现极端比特率的降低和超低纬度流化，通过它的12.5Hz，16层多码簿设计以及轻量因子ConvNet，使得立即的第一包排放(97，ms)成为可能。广泛的实验表明跨越不同客观和主观基准(如TTS多语种测试集，InstructTTSEval，以及我们的长语音测试集)的先进性能。为了促进社区研发，我们根据Apache 2.0许可证发布了标致剂和模型。

items.detail: The advent of 1-bit large language models (LLMs), led by BitNet b1.58, has spurred interest in ternary LLMs. Despite this, research and practical applications focusing on efficient edge inference for ternary LLMs remain scarce. To bridge this gap, we introduce Bitnet.cpp, an inference system optimized for BitNet b1.58 and ternary LLMs. Given that mixed-precision matrix multiplication (mpGEMM) constitutes the bulk of inference time in ternary LLMs, Bitnet.cpp incorporates a novel mpGEMM library to facilitate sub-2-bits-per-weight, efficient and lossless inference. The library features two core solutions: Ternary Lookup Table (TL), which addresses spatial inefficiencies of previous bit-wise methods, and Int2 with a Scale (I2_S), which ensures lossless edge inference, both enabling high-speed inference. Our experiments show that Bitnet.cpp achieves up to a 6.25x increase in speed over full-precision baselines and up to 2.32x over low-bit baselines, setting new benchmarks in the field. Additionally, we expand TL to element-wise lookup table (ELUT) for low-bit LLMs in the appendix, presenting both theoretical and empirical evidence of its considerable potential. Bitnet.cpp is publicly available at https://github.com/microsoft/BitNet/tree/paper , offering a sophisticated solution for the efficient and practical deployment of edge LLMs.
items.title_zh: Bitnet.cpp：特尔纳里LLMs的高效边缘推论
items.detail_zh: 由 BitNet b1.58 牵头的1位大语言模型(LLM)的出现，激发了对ternary LLMs的兴趣。尽管如此，侧重于三边法学硕士的有效边缘推论的研究和实际应用仍然很少。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了Bitnet.cpp，一个为BitNet b1.58和ternary LLMs优化的推论系统。鉴于混合精度矩阵乘法(mpGEMM)构成Ternary LLMs的大部分推论时间， Bitnet.cpp 包含了一款新的 mpGEMM 库来方便子-2位/人/人/人/人/人的推论。该库有两个核心解决方案：Trinary Lookup Table(TL)，它解决了以前位取方法的空间效率低下问题；和I2 S的Int2，它确保了无损失的边缘推论，两者都有利于高速推论。我们的实验显示，Bitnet.cpp比全精度基线达到6.25x增速，比低位基线达到2.32x增速，为球场设定了新的基准。此外，我们还将TL扩展为附录中低位 LLMs 的元素取向表(ELUT)，提出了其巨大潜力的理论和经验证据。 Bitnet.cpp可在https://github.com/microsoft/BitNet/tree/paper上公开查阅，为有效实际部署边缘有限责任公司提供了一个复杂的解决方案。

items.detail: Vision-language models (VLMs) pretrained on large-scale multimodal datasets encode rich visual and linguistic knowledge, making them a strong foundation for robotics. Rather than training robotic policies from scratch, recent approaches adapt VLMs into vision-language-action (VLA) models that enable natural language-driven perception and control. However, existing VLAs are typically massive--often with billions of parameters--leading to high training costs and limited real-world deployability. Moreover, they rely on academic and industrial datasets, overlooking the growing availability of community-collected data from affordable robotic platforms. In this work, we present SmolVLA, a small, efficient, and community-driven VLA that drastically reduces both training and inference costs, while retaining competitive performance. SmolVLA is designed to be trained on a single GPU and deployed on consumer-grade GPUs or even CPUs. To further improve responsiveness, we introduce an asynchronous inference stack decoupling perception and action prediction from action execution, allowing higher control rates with chunked action generation. Despite its compact size, SmolVLA achieves performance comparable to VLAs that are 10x larger. We evaluate SmolVLA on a range of both simulated as well as real-world robotic benchmarks and release all code, pretrained models, and training data.
items.title_zh: SmolVLA：经济适用和高效机器人的愿景-语言-行动模型
items.detail_zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)在大规模多式联运数据集上预训，编码了丰富的视觉和语言知识，使其成为机器人学的坚实基础。近期的方法不是从零开始培训机器人政策，而是将VLMs改造为视觉语言动作(VLA)模型，使自然语言驱动的感知和控制成为可能。然而，现有的志愿军通常规模很大，往往有数十亿个参数，导致培训费用高昂，实际世界部署能力有限。此外，它们依靠学术和工业数据集，忽略了社区从负担得起的机器人平台收集的越来越多的数据。在这项工作中，我们介绍了SmolVLA，这是一个小型、高效和社区驱动的VLA，它大大减少了培训和推论费用，同时保留了竞争性业绩。 SmolVLA的设计是在单一GPU上进行训练，并部署在消费级GPU甚至CPU上。为了进一步提高反应能力，我们引入了一个同步推论堆栈，将感知和行动预测与动作执行脱钩，从而能够用块状动作生成来提高控制率。尽管SmolVLA的体积比较紧凑，但能达到与10x更大的VLA相当的性能。我们用一系列模拟和现实世界的机器人基准来评估SmolVLA，并发布所有代码，预先训练的模型和培训数据。

items.detail: Visual backbones have evolved from Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) with local aggregation to Vision Transformers (ViTs) with global interactions, State-Space Models (SSMs) with input-dependent state transitions, and Test-Time Training (TTT) layers that adapt an inner learner while processing an image. Across this progression, visual computation has become increasingly adaptive to each input, yet the rules governing that adaptation remain largely prescribed by the trained backbone. We introduce VisionHOPE, the first generic visual backbone formulated as a self-modifying learning system, in which what the model remembers and how it learns co-evolve within an image. Building on the self-referential construction of Nested Learning (NL), VisionHOPE realizes this co-evolution through five coupled memories that store content, generate key and value representations, and govern learning rate and retention. These memories evolve jointly as visual context accumulates along each scan. However, directly applying the unconstrained self-referential update to a visual backbone leads to instability. We therefore derive a stability-matched step-size control scheme that combines a soft cap on self-referential injection with a spectral clamp on the retained memory transition, and prove that the resulting memory dynamics are non-expansive along each scan. For two-dimensional feature maps, we adapt NL's chunk formulation by aligning chunks with image rows and columns across four directional scans. The proposed VisionHOPE achieves competitive results on ImageNet-1K, COCO, and ADE20K, establishing self-modifying learning systems as a practical foundation for general-purpose visual backbones. The code is available at https://github.com/PSRben/VisionHOPE.
items.title_zh: 愿景：视觉背骨作为自我改进的学习系统
items.detail_zh: 视觉骨干已经从Convolutional Neural Networks(CNNs)演变而来，局部聚合到具有全球互动的ViTs(ViTs)，具有投入依赖状态过渡的State-Space Models(SSM)，以及在处理图像的同时适应内在学习者的TTT(TTT)层。通过这一进展，视觉计算越来越适应于每项投入，然而，关于适应的规则基本上仍然由经过培训的骨干部门规定。我们介绍VisionHOPE，这是第一个作为自我改造的学习系统而形成的通用视觉骨干，在这个系统中，模型记忆了什么，它是如何在图像中共同学习的。在Nested Learning(NL)的自我偏好构建的基础上，VisionHOPE通过存储内容，生成关键和价值表述，规范学习率和保留率的五种组合记忆，实现了这种共同演变。这些记忆随着视觉上下文在每次扫描过程中的积累而共同演化。然而，将不受约束的自我优惠更新直接应用到视觉骨干上会导致不稳定。因此，我们得出一个稳定相匹配的阶梯大小控制方案，将自偏性注射的软盖与保留内存过渡的光谱夹结合起来，并证明所产生的内存动态在每次扫描过程中都是非扩展的。对于二维特征图，我们调整NL的块式配方，通过四个方向扫描将块与图像行和列对齐。拟议的VisualHOPE在ImageNet-1K，COCO，ADE20K上取得了竞争结果，建立了自我修改的学习系统，作为通用视觉骨干的实际基础。该代码可在https://github.com/PSRben/VisionHOPE查询。

items.detail: Streaming 3D reconstruction aims to recover 3D information, such as camera poses and point clouds, from a video stream, which necessitates geometric accuracy, temporal consistency, and computational efficiency. Motivated by the principles of Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM), we introduce LingBot-Map, a feed-forward 3D foundation model for reconstructing scenes from streaming data, built upon a geometric context transformer (GCT) architecture. A defining aspect of LingBot-Map lies in its carefully designed attention mechanism, which integrates an anchor context, a pose-reference window, and a trajectory memory to address coordinate grounding, dense geometric cues, and long-range drift correction, respectively. This design keeps the streaming state compact while retaining rich geometric context, enabling stable efficient inference at around 20 FPS on 518 x 378 resolution inputs over long sequences exceeding 10,000 frames. Extensive evaluations across a variety of benchmarks demonstrate that our approach achieves superior performance compared to both existing streaming and iterative optimization-based approaches.
items.title_zh: 流出 三维重建的几何上下文变换器
items.detail_zh: 流出3D重建旨在从视频流中恢复相机姿势和点云等3D信息，这需要几何精度，时间一致性和计算效率。以同步本地化和绘图(SLAM)的原理为动机，我们引入了LingBot-Map，这是从流数据重建场景的向导3D地基模型，以几何上下文变压器(GCT)架构为基础。 LingBot-Map的一个决定性方面在于它精心设计的注意机制，它分别结合了锚地上下文，姿势参考窗口，以及处理坐标地平线，密度几何提示和远程漂移修正的轨迹记忆。这种设计保持了流体状态紧凑，同时保留了丰富的几何上下文，使得在518×378分辨率输入器上，在超过一万帧的长序上，约能有20个FPS的稳定高效推论。对各种基准的广泛评价表明，与现有的流式和迭代优化办法相比，我们的方法取得了更好的业绩。

items.detail: Agentic coding tools receive goals written in natural language as input, break them down into specific tasks, and write or execute the actual code with minimal human intervention. Central to this process are agent context files ("READMEs for agents") that provide persistent, project-level instructions. In this paper, we conduct the first large-scale empirical study of 2,303 agent context files from 1,925 repositories to characterize their structure, maintenance, and content. We find that these files are not static documentation but complex, difficult-to-read artifacts that evolve like configuration code, maintained through frequent, small additions. Our content analysis of 16 instruction types shows that developers prioritize functional context, such as build and run commands (62.3%), implementation details (69.9%), and architecture (67.7%). We also identify a significant gap: non-functional requirements like security (14.5%) and performance (14.5%) are rarely specified. These findings indicate that while developers use context files to make agents functional, they provide few guardrails to ensure that agent-written code is secure or performant, highlighting the need for improved tooling and practices.
items.title_zh: 代理 READMEs：代理编码背景文件的实证研究
items.detail_zh: 代理编码工具接收以自然语言写成的目标作为输入，将其细分为具体任务，并在最小的人类干预下编写或执行实际代码。这个过程的核心是代理上下文文件("用于代理的READMEs")，提供持久，项目级指令。在本文中，我们对来自1,925个寄存器的2,303个代理上下文文件进行了第一次大规模的实证研究，以描述其结构、维护和内容。我们发现，这些文件不是静态文件，而是复杂，难以阅读的文物，它们像配置代码一样演化，通过频繁的小添加来维护。我们对16种指令类型的内容分析显示，开发者优先排序功能环境，如构建和运行命令(62.3%)，实施细节(69.9%)，以及架构(67.7%)。我们还发现存在一个重大差距：安保(14.5%)和业绩(14.5%)等不起作用的要求很少得到说明。这些发现表明，开发者虽然使用上下文文件来使代理机功能化，但是他们提供很少的护栏来保证代理机写代码的安全性或性能，突出了改进工具和做法的必要性。

items.detail: Multi-agent systems often rely on predefined collaboration structures, limiting their ability to adapt to diverse task requirements. We introduce DynaFlow, a framework that integrates free-form executable workflow synthesis into the action space of the main agent. The agent decides when collaboration is needed and generates task-specific programs that coordinate sub-agents through sequential or parallel execution, structured information exchange, and verification. Execution results and traces inform subsequent actions, enabling the agent to adapt collaboration as reasoning progresses. We train only the main agent through supervised fine-tuning on distilled trajectories, followed by refinement on examples filtered for unsupported premises, biased verification, and information-flow defects. All sub-agents remain fixed, separating orchestration learning from executor capability improvement. Across six benchmarks spanning mathematical reasoning, scientific question answering, and multi-hop retrieval, DynaFlow achieves 88.08% overall accuracy in Forced mode, outperforming the strongest evaluated baseline by 10.90 percentage points with the same Qwen3.5-27B backbone. Workflow analysis finds more explicit use, verification, and refinement of upstream outputs after training, highlighting cross-stage information flow as a key dimension of multi-agent orchestration.
items.title_zh: DynaFlow：学习自由形式多代理管弦乐团
items.detail_zh: 多代理系统往往依赖预先定义的协作结构，限制了它们适应不同任务要求的能力。我们引入了 DynaFlow，这个框架将自由形式可执行的工作流程合成集成到主要代理的动作空间中。代理商决定何时需要合作，并生成任务特定程序，通过相继执行或并行执行，结构化的信息交换，以及核查来协调子代理商。执行结果和追踪为后续行动提供了信息，使代理人能够随着推理的进展而适应协作。我们仅通过对蒸馏出轨迹进行有监督的微调来培训主要剂剂，然后对为无支持的房舍过滤出的例子、有偏见的核查和信息流缺陷进行改进。所有副代理人保持固定状态，将管弦乐学习与执行者能力提高区分开来。 DynaFlow在包括数学推理、科学问题回答和多跳检索在内的6个基准中，在强制模式中实现了88.08%的总精度，比最强的评价基准高出10.90个百分点，拥有相同的Quen3.5-27B骨干。工作流程分析发现，培训后上游产出得到更明确的使用、核查和完善，强调跨阶段信息流动是多代理协调的一个关键方面。

items.detail: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as long-term interactive agents, yet their limited context windows make it difficult to sustain coherent behavior over extended interactions. Existing memory systems often store isolated records and retrieve fragments, limiting their ability to consolidate evolving user states and resolve conflicts. We introduce EverMemOS, a self-organizing memory operating system that implements an engram-inspired lifecycle for computational memory. Episodic Trace Formation converts dialogue streams into MemCells that capture episodic traces, atomic facts, and time-bounded Foresight signals. Semantic Consolidation organizes MemCells into thematic MemScenes, distilling stable semantic structures and updating user profiles. Reconstructive Recollection performs MemScene-guided agentic retrieval to compose the necessary and sufficient context for downstream reasoning. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval show that EverMemOS achieves state-of-the-art performance on memory-augmented reasoning tasks. We further report a profile study on PersonaMem v2 and qualitative case studies illustrating chat-oriented capabilities such as user profiling and Foresight. Code is available at https://github.com/EverMind-AI/EverMemOS.
items.title_zh: EverMemOS：结构化长视距内存操作系统
items.detail_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)作为长期互动代理越来越多地被部署，然而其有限的上下文窗口使得在扩展互动上难以维持连贯的行为。现有的内存系统经常存储孤立的记录并检索碎片，限制了它们巩固不断发展的用户状态和解决冲突的能力。我们引入了 EverMemOS，一个自组织内存操作系统，它执行一个被engram启发的生命周期用于计算内存。 Episodic Trace Formation 将对话框流转换成MemCells，可以捕捉偶发的痕迹，原子事实，以及有时限的前瞻信号。语义整合将MemCells组织成主题的MemScens，蒸馏稳定的语义结构并更新用户简介。重构回想执行 MemScene 制导的代理检索，为下游推理创造必要和充分的上下文。 LoCoMo和LongMemEval上的实验显示，EverMemOS在内存增强推理任务上实现了最先进的性能。我们还报告关于PersonaMem v2的概况研究，以及定性案例研究，说明以聊天为导向的能力，如用户剖析和展望。代码见https://github.com/EverMind-AI/EverMemOS。

items.title: LlamaFactory: Unified Efficient Fine-Tuning of 100+ Language Models
items.subtitle: Efficient fine-tuning is vital for adapting large language models (LLMs) to downstream tasks. However, it requires non-trivial efforts to implement these methods on different models. We present LlamaFactory, a unified framework that integrates a suite of cutting-edge efficient training methods. It allows users to flexibly customize the fine-tuning of 100+ LLMs without the need for coding through the built-in web UI LlamaBoard. We empirically validate the efficiency and effectiveness of our framework on language modeling and text generation tasks. It has been released at https://github.com/hiyouga/LLaMA-Factory and already received over 13,000 stars and 1,600 forks.

items.detail: We introduce 3DCodeVerse, a research ecosystem that enables coding agents to create editable and verifiable 3D content at scale. 3DCodeVerse comprises large-scale, high-quality datasets of executable 3D code, a coding harness for spatial reasoning and automated verification, and practical guidance for 3D coding. First, we construct 3DCodeVerse-2M, a large-scale curated dataset of standalone 3D executable code. We build this corpus by collecting open-source data, converting specialized representations, and generating new programs with coding agents. Each program is packaged with the source files and associated assets required for execution in its declared environment, along with available descriptions and verification records. Second, we develop the 3DCodeVerse Harness, a multi-agent directed acyclic graph framework for generating and refining 3D content. It uses execution checks, spatial measurements, and visual feedback to automatically evaluate and revise generated programs without human feedback during generation. Third, we conduct systematic empirical studies of 3D coding, establishing baselines with fine-tuned open models and deriving practical guidance through component-level analyses of our harness. Extensive experiments demonstrate that fine-tuning on our dataset significantly improves the 3D coding capabilities of open-source models. Notably, our 3DCodeVerse harness achieves a 90% win rate against Claude Design (3D Object) in pairwise human evaluations, when both are utilized by Claude Opus 5.5.
items.title_zh: 3DCodeVerse：将3D世界作为代码探索
items.detail_zh: 我们引入了3DCodeVerse，一个研究生态系统，它使编码代理能够大规模创建可编辑和可核查的3D内容。 3DCodeVerse包含可执行的3D代码的大规模高质量数据集，用于空间推理和自动化验证的编码工具，以及3D编码的实用指导。首先，我们构建了3DCodeVerse-2M，一个由独立3D可执行代码组成的大规模编译数据集。我们通过收集开源数据、转换专门表述和用编码代理生成新程序来建立这一工具。每个程序都有在其申报环境中执行所需的源文件和相关资产以及可用的描述和核查记录。第二，我们开发了3DCodeVerse Harness，这是一个多剂定向的循环图框架，用于生成和精炼3D内容。它使用执行检查，空间测量，以及视觉反馈，在生成过程中自动评估和修改生成的程序，而无需人类反馈。第三，我们对三维编码进行系统的经验性研究，确定基线，采用经过微调的开放模型，并通过对我们的利用情况进行组件层面的分析，获得实际指导。广泛的实验表明，我们数据集的微调大大改善了开源模型的3D编码能力。值得注意的是，我们的3DCodeVerse控制器在Claude Design(3D Object)的双向人评价中实现了90%的胜率，而Claude Opus 5.5则使用了两者。

items.detail: High-resolution video matting requires preserving fine details, such as hair strands and soft transparency, while maintaining consistency across frames. Memory-based methods achieve strong matting quality by matching current-frame features with information stored from earlier frames, but this process becomes increasingly costly as resolution grows. We present MatAnyone-E, an efficient extension of MatAnyone 2 that focuses computation where it is most needed. Our approach first performs low-resolution propagation to identify uncertain regions that require closer inspection and the memory candidates most relevant to them. It then performs high-resolution matching only for these regions using the selected memory, while reusing low-resolution matching results elsewhere. This strategy reduces both the number of locations requiring detailed matching and the amount of memory searched, while preserving the information needed to produce a complete matte. We further reduce the cost of generating high-resolution mattes with a lightweight decoder designed around measured runtime bottlenecks and trained to reproduce the original decoder's representations. Experiments show that MatAnyone-E maintains matting quality comparable to MatAnyone 2 while achieving an estimated 7.4x inference speedup and reducing peak GPU memory usage to 7.6% of the usage of MatAnyone 2 at 4K. With compilation-enabled inference on a single NVIDIA H200 GPU, it reaches 73.07 FPS at 1080p and 28.62 FPS at 4K.
items.title_zh: MatAnyone-E：高效高分辨率视频编审的 sparse 内存宣传
items.detail_zh: 高分辨的视频交配需要保存细细的细节，如发线和软透明，同时保持跨帧的一致性。基于内存的方法通过将当前帧特征与从更早的帧所储存的信息相匹配来达到强烈的搭配质量，但随着分辨率的增加，这一过程变得日益昂贵。我们介绍MatAnyone-E，这是MatAnyone 2的有效扩展，它把计算重点放在最需要的地方。我们的方法首先进行低分辨率的传播，以查明需要更密切检查的不确定区域以及与其最相关的记忆候选人。然后它只使用所选的内存对这些区域进行高分辨率匹配，同时在其他地方使用低分辨率匹配结果。这一策略既能减少需要详细匹配的地点数量，又能减少内存被搜索的数量，同时能保存产生完整mate所需的信息。我们进一步降低产生高分辨率的垫子的成本，并用一个轻量级的解码器来设计围绕所测量的运行时间瓶颈，并经过训练来复制原始解码器的表示。实验显示，MatAnyone-E保持了与MatAnyone 2相仿的交配质量，同时实现了估计的7.4x推论速度并将顶峰GPU内存使用率降低到4K时MatAnyone 2的7.6%。通过对单NVIDIA H200 GPU的编译推论，在1080p时达到73.07FPS，在4K时达到28.62FPS。

items.detail: One of the grand challenges of artificial general intelligence is developing agents capable of conducting scientific research and discovering new knowledge. While frontier models have already been used as aids to human scientists, e.g. for brainstorming ideas, writing code, or prediction tasks, they still conduct only a small part of the scientific process. This paper presents the first comprehensive framework for fully automatic scientific discovery, enabling frontier large language models to perform research independently and communicate their findings. We introduce The AI Scientist, which generates novel research ideas, writes code, executes experiments, visualizes results, describes its findings by writing a full scientific paper, and then runs a simulated review process for evaluation. In principle, this process can be repeated to iteratively develop ideas in an open-ended fashion, acting like the human scientific community. We demonstrate its versatility by applying it to three distinct subfields of machine learning: diffusion modeling, transformer-based language modeling, and learning dynamics. Each idea is implemented and developed into a full paper at a cost of less than $15 per paper. To evaluate the generated papers, we design and validate an automated reviewer, which we show achieves near-human performance in evaluating paper scores. The AI Scientist can produce papers that exceed the acceptance threshold at a top machine learning conference as judged by our automated reviewer. This approach signifies the beginning of a new era in scientific discovery in machine learning: bringing the transformative benefits of AI agents to the entire research process of AI itself, and taking us closer to a world where endless affordable creativity and innovation can be unleashed on the world's most challenging problems. Our code is open-sourced at https://github.com/SakanaAI/AI-Scientist
items.title_zh: AI科学家：走向完全自动化的不限名额科学发现
items.detail_zh: 人工一般情报的巨大挑战之一是培养能够进行科学研究并发现新知识的特工。虽然前沿模型已经被用作人类科学家的辅助工具，例如用于集思广益思想，写作守则或预测任务，但它们仍然只进行一小部分科学进程。本文件介绍了第一个全自动科学发现的全面框架，使前沿大型语言模型能够独立地进行研究并交流其研究成果。我们介绍AI科学家，它生成出小说研究思想，写出代码，执行实验，可视化结果，通过写出完整的科学论文来描述其发现，然后运行模拟的评审过程来进行评估。原则上，这一过程可以重复进行，以无限制的方式反复地发展出思想，像人类科学界一样发挥作用。我们通过将其应用到机器学习的三个不同的子领域，即扩散模型、以变压器为基础的语言模型和学习动力学，来证明它的多功能性。每一个想法都得到落实并发展成一份完整的论文，每张论文的成本不到15美元。为了评价生成的论文，我们设计并验证了一个自动审查员，我们显示在评价论文分数方面实现了近乎人类的性能。 AI科学家可以在最高机器学习会上提出超过接受阈值的论文，由我们的自动审查员判断。这种方法标志着机器学习科学发现新时代的开始：将AI代理的变革性利益带入AI本身的整个研究过程，并使我们更接近于一个能够对世界上最具挑战性的问题释放出无尽的可负担的创造力和创新力的世界。我们的代码开源于https://github.com/SakanaAI/AI-科学家

Building a playable game requires coordinating code, scenes, assets, animations, physics, and configurations, while allowing developers to validate their integrated behavior through interactive testing. items.detail: Large language model agents have enabled software development through natural-language interaction, but extending this paradigm to end-to-end game development remains challenging. Building a playable game requires coordinating code, scenes, assets, animations, physics, and configurations, while allowing developers to validate their integrated behavior through interactive testing. We introduce VibeGame, a framework for creating complete 2D game projects from natural-language prompts and optional reference images. Its AI-native game engine represents project state as schema-validated structured text and provides frame-synchronous runtime control, enabling agents to inspect game states, execute actions, and verify behavior at their own pace. Built upon this interface, we design an Adversarial Agent Team of eight specialized agents to separate implementation from review, so that problems are found and fixed through multi-round loops. For each conducted and accepted project, we further introduce a training-free self-evolution mechanism to distill it into reusable skeletons, modules, and collaboration contracts for future development. We evaluate prompt-assets-to-game (PA2G), where agents are given an asset library, and prompt-to-game (P2G), where agents generate their own art. On a GameCraft-Bench subset, VibeGame in P2G consistently outperforms a range of agent harnesses in either P2G or PA2G with the same underlying model, including GPT-6.1-Sol.
items.title_zh: VibeGame：与AI-Native引擎和自演的Aversari代理团队进行快速对Game开发。
items.detail_zh: 大语言模型代理商通过自然语言互动使软件开发成为可能，但将这一范式扩展到端到端的游戏开发仍然具有挑战性。构建可玩游戏需要协调代码，场景，资产，动画，物理，和配置，同时允许开发者通过互动测试验证其综合行为。我们引入了 VibeGame，这是一个从自然语言的提示和可选的参考图像创建完整的2D游戏项目的框架。其AI-native游戏引擎代表工程状态为schema-valided结构化文本，并提供帧同步运行时间控制，使代理机能够检查游戏状态，执行动作，并以自己的速度验证行为。在这个接口上，我们设计了一个由8个专门代理人组成的Aversarial Agent Team，将执行与审查区分开来，以便发现问题并通过多轮循环加以解决。对于每个开展和接受的项目，我们进一步引入了无培训的自演机制，将其提炼成可重复使用的骨架、模块和今后发展的合作合同。我们评价即时资产对游戏(PA2G)，即给予代理商一个资产库，以及即时对游戏(P2G)，即代理商自己生成艺术。在GameCraft-Bench子集上，P2G中的VibeGame在P2G或PA2G中以相同的基本模型，包括GPT-6.1-Sol，一贯地超过一系列的代理牵引。

items.detail: Conversational systems, such as duplex speech language models (SLMs), still lack a streaming, accurate, and empathetic memory system as their soul. We introduce VoiceMem, a simple memory architecture with a parallel informational left brain, an emotional right brain, and streaming memory I/O mechanisms. We further build a complete pipeline for memory-aware SLM training, long-horizon evaluation, and decoupled deployment with interchangeable memory backends. Experiments and real-world deployment show three advantages: i) Accuracy: under top-5 retrieval, the left brain outperforms classical systems such as Mem0 at top-200 by nearly 30 points; ii) Emotional & Personal: the right brain, with short- and long-horizon affective attribution and dual-node persona modeling, achieves state-of-the-art performance across three persona benchmarks and improves the aggregate score by 4.29 points over the previous best system; and iii) Real-Time & Cheap: VoiceMem completes retrieval in 134 ms, well within standard VAD latency, adding no extra conversational delay while maintaining high accuracy and low cost. These results show that VoiceMem provides a practical memory foundation for real-time, personalized, and emotionally aware speech interaction.
items.title_zh: VoiceMem：流动双脑内存用于实时互动
items.detail_zh: 对话式系统，如双倍语音语言模型(SLMS)，仍然缺乏作为灵魂的流体，准确性和爱心记忆系统。我们引入了VoiceMem，一个简单的记忆架构，它具有平行的信息左脑，情感右脑，以及流传的记忆I/O机制。我们进一步为记忆意识的可持续土地管理培训、长视野评估以及与可互换记忆后端脱钩的部署搭建了完整的管道。实验和现实世界部署显示三个优点： (一)精准度：在最高-5检索下，左脑在最高-200的Mem0等古典系统上以近30分超越； (二)情感与个人：右脑，具有短和长距离的反感归属和双节点人物模型，在三个人物基准上实现最先进的性能，比之前的最佳系统提高总分4.29分； (三)实时与便宜度：声音Mem完成134ms的检索，远在标准的VAD空位内，在保持高精度和低成本的同时，不增加额外的对话延迟。这些结果表明，VoiceMem为实时，个性化，情感意识的语音互动提供了实用的记忆基础。

items.detail: Real-world forgery is inherently heterogeneous: it manifests not only as digital manipulation but also as physical spoofing, and is carried not only by images but also by videos. Despite substantial progress, a unified anti-forgery foundation model covering such a broad threat spectrum remains absent. In this paper, we present Venus-DefakerOne2, which substantially extends the forensic capability boundary along both the forgery-form and media-type dimensions. Trained on tens of millions of open-source and in-house samples, it incorporates two key designs. Tide-Style-Tuning alternates LoRA and full-parameter fine-tuning to balance computational efficiency, generalization, and hard-sample fitting while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Entropy-based Test Adaptation determines the optimal prediction modality by analyzing prediction entropy. Venus-DefakerOne2 achieves new state-of-the-art performance across a comprehensive suite of benchmarks, including DeepFake faces (96.7%), AI-generated images (93.3%), tampered documents (87.6%), manipulated natural images (89.6%), physical spoofs (93.1%), and AI-generated videos (96.0%). It significantly outperforms both specialized expert models and its predecessor, DefakerOne, establishing itself as a powerful and versatile foundation model for binary-decision forensic tasks.

items.detail_zh: 真实世界的伪造本身是多种多样的：它不仅表现为数字操纵，而且表现为实际的作弊，不仅通过图像，而且通过视频进行。尽管取得了实质性进展，但仍然缺乏涵盖如此广泛的威胁范围的统一的反伪造基础模式。在本文中，我们介绍了维纳斯-德法克One2，它大大地扩展了法证能力界线，沿伪造形式和媒介类型的维度。它对数千万个开源和内部样本进行了培训，纳入了两个关键设计。 Tide-Style-Tuning 候补 LORA和全参数的微调，以平衡计算效率，通俗化，硬样本相适应，同时减轻灾难性的遗忘。基于Entropy的测试适应通过分析预测的Entropy来确定最佳预测模式。 Venus-DefakerOne2通过一套综合基准实现新的最新性能，包括Deep Fake面孔(96.7%)、AI生成的图像(93.3%)、被篡改的文件(87.6%)、被操纵的自然图像(89.6%)、物理假象(93.1%)和AI生成的视频(96.0%)。它的绩效大大超过专业专家模型及其前身Defaker One，将自己确立为二元决定法证任务的强大多能的基础模型。

items.detail: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) aims to transform interaction experience into persistent improvements, yet external feedback is costly and world-model predictions may become unreliable as policies evolve. We introduce RSI-Anything, a domain-general framework built on JEPA-Anything that uses predictive world models to guide action and learning-data selection. Observed feedback drives policy or workflow improvement and conditional world-model adaptation, while component and compatibility checks govern the retention of updated policy-model pairs. Across diverse computational and scientific domains, RSI-Anything demonstrates substantial gains. In code repair, with the coder fixed, success increases from 26.3% with a static verifier to 29.2% through predictive selection and 31.2% after world-model adaptation, at comparable test usage. Graphical user interface (GUI) evaluations showed higher task completion, while average actions decrease by 39.4%. Across five successive policy versions, laboratory-planning scores more than double from 21.80% to 46.01%. In reaction optimization, RSI-Anything achieves 96.15% mean best observed yield versus 82.16% for Bayesian optimization under the same 40-experiment budget. An end-to-end immune-science application further connects workflow evolution and predictive modeling with therapeutic hypothesis generation. These results demonstrate how predictive world models and retained system updates enable recursive improvement across diverse environments.
items.title_zh: RSI-任何东西：与世界模型解锁回转自我改进
items.detail_zh: 递增自强(RSI)旨在将互动经验转化为持久的改进，然而外部反馈成本高昂，随着政策的发展，世界模型预测可能变得不可靠。我们介绍了RSI-Anything，这是建立在JEPA-Anything基础上的域总框架，它使用预测性的世界模型来指导行动和学习数据选择。所观察到的反馈驱动着政策或工作流程的改进和有条件的世界模型改造，而组件和相容性检查则制约着更新后的政策模型对子的保存。在各个不同的计算和科学领域，RSI-任何东西都显示出了巨大的收益。在代码修复中，经过编码器的固定，通过预测选择，成功率从静态验证器的26.3%提高到29.2%，在世界模型改造后，成功率从31.2%提高到可比测试用量。图形用户界面评价显示任务完成率较高，而平均行动减少39.4%。在连续五个政策版本中，实验室规划的得分从21.80%上升到46.01%，翻了一番多。在反应优化中，RSI-Anything实现96.15%的观测收益率最高，而Bayesian在相同的40实验预算下实现的优化为82.16%。端到端的免疫科学应用进一步将工作流程演化和预测模型与治疗假说生成联系起来。这些结果表明，预测性的世界模型和保留的系统更新如何使各种环境中的递归性改进得以进行。

items.detail: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is increasingly deployed in enterprise search and document-centric assistants, where responses must be grounded in long and complex source materials. In practice, verifying that generated answers faithfully reflect retrieved documents is difficult: large language models can check long contexts but are too slow and costly for interactive services, while lightweight classifiers operate within strict context limits and frequently miss evidence outside truncated passages. We present the design of a real-time verification component integrated into a production RAG pipeline that enables full-document grounding under latency constraints. The system processes documents up to 32K tokens and employs adaptive inference strategies to balance response time and verification coverage across workloads. We describe the architectural decisions, operational trade-offs, and evaluation methodology used to deploy the verifier, and show that full-context verification substantially improves detection of unsupported responses compared with truncated validation. Our experience highlights when long-context verification is necessary, why chunk-based checking often fails in real documents, and how latency budgets shape model design. These findings provide practical guidance for practitioners building reliable large-scale retrieval-augmented applications. (Model, benchmark, and code: https://huggingface.co/llm-semantic-router)
items.title_zh: 快速而忠实：长文件检索强化生成系统的实时验证
items.detail_zh: 在企业搜索和以文件为中心的助理中，越来越多地部署检索增强的生成(RAG)，这些助理的反应必须基于长期和复杂的原始材料。在实践中，核查生成的答案忠实地反映检索到的文档是困难的：大型语言模型可以检查较长的上下文，但对于交互服务来说太慢和成本太高，而轻量级分类器在严格的上下文限制下运行，经常在截断的段落之外错过证据。我们提出将实时核查部分纳入生产RAG管道的设计，以便在暂时性限制下全面铺设文件。该系统处理多达32K令牌的文件，并采用适应性的推断战略，以平衡反应时间和工作量的核查范围。我们描述了用于部署核查员的建筑决定、业务权衡和评价方法，并表明，与短时间验证相比，全文核查大大改进了对无支持答复的检测。我们的经验突出表明，何时需要长文核查，为什么在真实文件中往往不进行块式检查，以及预算如何塑造模型。这些研究结果为从业人员建设可靠的大规模检索强化应用程序提供了实际指导。 (模式、基准和代码：https://huggingface.co/llm-semantic-router)

items.title: Agent^2 RL-Bench: Can LLM Agents Engineer Agentic RL Post-Training?

RL post-training increasingly drives model alignment and specialization, yet existing benchmarks are largely static, rewarding supervised fine-tuning or script generation without assessing an agent's ability to close an interactive RL loop. items.detail: We introduce Agent2 RL-Bench, a compact diagnostic benchmark for evaluating agentic RL post-training, which tests whether LLM agents can autonomously design, implement, debug, and execute post-training pipelines that improve foundation models. RL post-training increasingly drives model alignment and specialization, yet existing benchmarks are largely static, rewarding supervised fine-tuning or script generation without assessing an agent's ability to close an interactive RL loop. Agent2 RL-Bench provides a unified agent-facing interface: each run starts from an isolated workspace containing a base model, task data, instructions, and a grading API, and agents must iterate within a fixed budget by training models and submitting artifacts for evaluation. The benchmark spans six tasks across three levels, from static rule-based training to judge-based optimization and closed-loop online RL with trajectory collection. Two diagnostic skills, namely runtime recording and post-hoc summarization, enable structured analysis of agent behavior, facilitating smooth and effective iteration of the benchmark's evaluation framework. Across five agent systems and six driver LLMs, agents show intelligent behavior but clear limitations: one RL-oriented run improves ALFWorld from 4.85 to 93.28 via SFT warm-up and GRPO with online rollouts, yet DeepSearchQA remains difficult, most successful routes rely on supervised pipelines, and interactive outcomes show large single-run differences across agent stacks. Overall, Agent2 RL-Bench shows that current agents can sometimes engineer online RL, but stable agent-driven RL post-training remains rare under fixed budgets. It also demonstrates that our benchmark provides a strong and effective evaluation framework for future research in this direction. Code is available at https://github.com/microsoft/RD-Agent/blob/main/rdagent/scenarios/rl/autorl_bench/README.md
items.title_zh: 代理 ^2 RL- Bench： LLM 代理 工程师 代理 RL 后训练？
items.detail_zh: 我们引入了Agent2 RL-Bench，这是评价代理RL后训练的紧凑诊断基准，该基准测试LLM代理是否能够自主地设计，执行，调试，以及执行改进基础模型的训练后管线。 RL后培训越来越能推动模型的对接和专业化，但现有的基准基本是静态的，奖励有监督的微调或脚本生成，而不评估代理商关闭交互式RL环的能力。 Agent2 RL-Bench提供了统一的代理-造型接口：每次运行都从一个孤立的工作空间开始，包含一个基础模型，任务数据，指令，以及一个分级的API，代理必须通过培训模型和提交文物进行评价，在固定预算范围内进行迭接。该基准跨越从静态规则培训到基于法官的优化和有轨迹收集的闭路在线RL等三个层面的6个任务。两种诊断技能，即运行时间记录和随机汇总后，能够对代理行为进行有条理的分析，促进基准评价框架的平稳和有效迭代。在五个代理系统和六个驱动程序LLMs中，代理显示智能行为，但有明显的局限性：一个面向RL的运行改进了ALFWorld，从4.85到93.28通过SFT热身和GPRO在线推出，然而DeepSearchQA仍然困难重重，大多数成功路线依赖于有监督的管线，互动结果显示各代理堆的单运行差异很大。总体而言，Agent2 RL-Bench显示，当前代理有时可以在线设计RL，但稳定代理驱动的RL后培训在固定预算下仍然罕见。它还表明，我们的基准为今后这方面的研究提供了有力而有效的评价框架。代码见https://github.com/microsoft/RD-Agent/blob/main/rdagent/scenarios/rl/autorl bench/README.md。

However, full attention incurs quadratic cost and, as resolution increases, spreads attention over increasingly redundant tokens, diluting learning signals for informative content and disrupting pretrained priors. items.detail: Natively training joint video-audio generation models at higher resolutions empowers them to learn richer visual details and sharper motion dynamics. However, full attention incurs quadratic cost and, as resolution increases, spreads attention over increasingly redundant tokens, diluting learning signals for informative content and disrupting pretrained priors. Existing sparse attention methods either target training-free acceleration or overlook the unique structure of joint video-audio data, where cross-modal interactions are inherently concentrated around sound-producing regions. To address this, we propose Prism, a dynamic sparse attention framework for natively training joint video-audio generation models at 2K. In particular, Prism organizes the token sequence into spatiotemporal macro-zones, enabling the attention structure to adapt to local content. For each zone, it estimates local information structure via video feature variance along the channel and feature norms from the audio-to-video cross-attention, jointly capturing how visual content varies directionally and how strongly audio influences each visual region. Based on these signals, Prism dynamically assigns a tailored block shape to each zone, applying finer partitioning along axes of rapid visual content variation and strong audio-visual coupling. This encourages tokens within each block to remain semantically coherent, allowing block-level features to capture both visual content and joint video-audio interaction patterns. Prism further adopts a hybrid block selection strategy to dynamically determine per-query sparsity. Experiments show that Prism achieves 2.5times training speedup compared to full attention, while surpassing it in generation quality.
items.title_zh: 棱镜：动态Sparse 关注土著 2K 联合视频-音频生成模式培训
items.detail_zh: 本土在更高分辨率下培训联合视频-音频生成模型，使得它们能够学习更丰富的视觉细节和更敏锐的运动动态。然而，充分关注会产生四重成本，随着分辨率的增加，注意力分散到日益冗余的标志上，对信息内容的学习信号进行稀释，并打乱事先受过训练的前科。现有的注意力稀少的方法要么针对无培训加速速度，要么忽略了联合视频-音频数据的独特结构，其中跨模式互动本质上集中在声音制作区域。为了解决这个问题，我们提议Prism，一个动态的稀疏关注框架，本地培训联合视频-音频生成模型 在2K。特别是Prism将符号序列组织成spatiopal宏区，使得关注结构能够适应本地内容。对于每个区域，它通过视频功能沿信道的差异和从音频到视频的交叉注意的特征规范来估计本地信息结构，共同捕捉视觉内容在方向上的差异，以及音频对每个视觉区域的影响。基于这些信号，棱柱动态地为每个区指定一个量身定制的块形，沿快速视觉内容变化和强烈的视听耦合的轴进行更细细的分割。这鼓励每个区块内的标志保持凝聚一致，让区块级的特性既能捕捉视觉内容，又能捕捉视频-音频联合互动模式。棱镜进一步采用了混合区块选择策略，以动态地确定每股冲压。实验显示，与全注意力相比，棱晶实现了2.5次训练加速，同时在生成质量上超过了它。

items.title: REMORY: Learning Residual Memory for Context Compaction

items.detail: Long-horizon agents compact their history to continue within a finite context window, but a textual summary alone may not support every subsequent decision. We introduce REMORY, a neural memory network that supplements the summary with a bounded sequence of soft memory tokens. Given the history and summary, the network learns to generate tokens that help a frozen LLM approximate the continuation it would produce with the full history. The tokens are conditioned on the summary and appended after it, forming an analogue of a residual connection along the sequence dimension. On SummHay, REMORY improves source attribution at nearly unchanged insight coverage and approaches the full-context joint score using only 5.2% of the input positions. Across long-horizon agent benchmarks, Qwen3.8-27B and GLM-5.3-Flash show consistent gains with residual memory. Both models also exhibit substantially fewer repeated tool outputs and tool errors on BrowseComp and Terminal-Bench 2.1.
items.title_zh: REMORY：学习残余内存用于背景缩合
items.detail_zh: 长视线代理人将自己的历史压缩在一个有限的上下文窗口中继续，但单是文字摘要可能不能支持以后的每一项决定。我们介绍REMORY，一个神经记忆网络，以软记忆符号的限定序列来补充摘要。鉴于历史和摘要，该网络学会生成一些符号，帮助冻结的LLM大致显示它将产生的完整历史的延续。符号以摘要为条件，并附在其之后，沿序列维形成一个剩余连接的类似物。在SummHay上，REMORY在近乎不变的洞察力覆盖下改进了源属性，并使用5.2%的输入位置接近全文联合得分。纵观长视剂基准，Qune3.8-27B和GLM-5.3-Flash在剩余内存方面显示出一致的收益。两种模型在浏览器Comp和终端-Bench 2.1上显示的重复工具输出和工具错误也大大减少。
