items.title: Fish Audio S2 Technical Report
items.subtitle: We introduce Fish Audio S2, an open-sourced text-to-speech system featuring multi-speaker, multi-turn generation, and, most importantly, instruction-following control via natural-language descriptions. items.detail: We introduce Fish Audio S2, an open-sourced text-to-speech system featuring multi-speaker, multi-turn generation, and, most importantly, instruction-following control via natural-language descriptions. To scale training, we develop a multi-stage training recipe together with a staged data pipeline covering video captioning and speech captioning, voice-quality assessment, and reward modeling. To push the frontier of open-source TTS, we release our model weights, fine-tuning code, and an SGLang-based inference engine. The inference engine is production-ready for streaming, achieving an RTF of 0.195 and a time-to-first-audio below 100 ms.Our code and weights are available on GitHub (https://github.com/fishaudio/fish-speech) and Hugging Face (https://huggingface.co/fishaudio/s2-pro). We highly encourage readers to visit https://fish.audio to try custom voices.

items.detail: Data-centric training has emerged as a promising direction for improving large language models (LLMs) by optimizing not only model parameters but also the selection, composition, and weighting of training data during optimization. However, existing approaches to data selection, data mixture optimization, and data reweighting are often developed in isolated codebases with inconsistent interfaces, hindering reproducibility, fair comparison, and practical integration. In this paper, we present DataFlex, a unified data-centric dynamic training framework built upon LLaMA-Factory. DataFlex supports three major paradigms of dynamic data optimization: sample selection, domain mixture adjustment, and sample reweighting, while remaining fully compatible with the original training workflow. It provides extensible trainer abstractions and modular components, enabling a drop-in replacement for standard LLM training, and unifies key model-dependent operations such as embedding extraction, inference, and gradient computation, with support for large-scale settings including DeepSpeed ZeRO-3. We conduct comprehensive experiments across multiple data-centric methods. Dynamic data selection consistently outperforms static full-data training on MMLU across both Mistral-7B and Llama-3.2-3B. For data mixture, DoReMi and ODM improve both MMLU accuracy and corpus-level perplexity over default proportions when pretraining Qwen2.5-1.5B on SlimPajama at 6B and 30B token scales. DataFlex also achieves consistent runtime improvements over original implementations. These results demonstrate that DataFlex provides an effective, efficient, and reproducible infrastructure for data-centric dynamic training of LLMs.
items.title_zh: DataFlex：大语言模型数据-儿童动态培训的统一框架
items.detail_zh: 以数据为中心的培训已成为改进大型语言模型的有希望的方向，不仅优化了模型参数，而且优化了培训数据的选择、组成和权重。然而，数据选择、数据混合物优化和数据重新加权的现有方法常常是在接口不一致的孤立代码库中开发的，阻碍了可复制性、公平比较和实际的整合。在本文中，我们介绍了DataFlex，这是一个基于LLaMA-Factory的统一的数据中心动态培训框架。 DataFlex支持动态数据优化的三个主要范式：样本选择，域混合调整，以及样本重置，同时保持与原始培训工作流程完全兼容。它提供了可扩展的教练抽象和模块化组件，使得标准LLM培训能够进行即时替换，并统一了嵌入提取，推论，梯度计算等依赖模型的关键操作，支持包括DeepSpeed ZeRO-3在内的大规模设置。我们通过多种以数据为中心的方法进行全面实验。动态数据选择在Mistral-7B和Llama-3.2-3B两地的MMLU静态全数据培训上，始终比其业绩要好。对于数据混合物，当在SlimPajama上预训Quen2.5-1.5B时，DoRemi和ODM在6B和30B符号尺度上提高MMLU的精度和实体级的复杂度，而不是默认比例。 DataFlex还实现了与原始执行相比的连续运行时间改进。这些结果表明，DataFlex为LLMs的数据中心动态培训提供了一个有效、高效和可复制的基础设施。

items.title: FunAudioLLM: Voice Understanding and Generation Foundation Models for Natural Interaction Between Humans and LLMs
items.subtitle: This report introduces FunAudioLLM, a model family designed to enhance natural voice interactions between humans and large language models (LLMs). At its core are two innovative models: SenseVoice, which handles multilingual speech recognition, emotion recognition, and audio event detection; and CosyVoice, which facilitates natural speech generation with control over multiple languages, timbre, speaking style, and speaker identity. items.detail: This report introduces FunAudioLLM, a model family designed to enhance natural voice interactions between humans and large language models (LLMs). At its core are two innovative models: SenseVoice, which handles multilingual speech recognition, emotion recognition, and audio event detection; and CosyVoice, which facilitates natural speech generation with control over multiple languages, timbre, speaking style, and speaker identity. SenseVoice-Small delivers exceptionally low-latency ASR for 5 languages, and SenseVoice-Large supports high-precision ASR for over 50 languages, while CosyVoice excels in multi-lingual voice generation, zero-shot in-context learning, cross-lingual voice cloning, and instruction-following capabilities. The models related to SenseVoice and CosyVoice have been open-sourced on Modelscope and Huggingface, along with the corresponding training, inference, and fine-tuning codes released on GitHub. By integrating these models with LLMs, FunAudioLLM enables applications such as speech-to-speech translation, emotional voice chat, interactive podcasts, and expressive audiobook narration, thereby pushing the boundaries of voice interaction technology. Demos are available at https://fun-audio-llm.github.io, and the code can be accessed at https://github.com/FunAudioLLM.
items.title_zh: FunAudioLLM：人类与LLMs之间自然互动的语音理解和生成基础模型
items.detail_zh: 这份报告介绍了FunAudioLLM，这是一个模型家族，旨在增强人类和大语言模型(LLM)之间的自然语音相互作用。其核心是两个创新模式：SenseVoice，它处理多语种语音识别，情感识别，和音频事件检测；和CosyVoice，它促进自然语音生成，控制多语言，平淡，说话风格，和扬声器身份。 SenseVoice-Small为5种语言提供极低纬度的ASR，SenseVoice-Large为50多种语言支持高精度ASR，而CosyVoice在多语言语音生成，零镜头的同声文字学习，跨语言语音克隆，以及教学跟踪能力方面表现优异。与SenseVoice和CosyVoice相关的模型已经在Modelscope和Huggingface上开源，同时在GitHub上发布了相应的训练，推论和微调代码。 FunAudioLLM通过将这些模型与LLMs集成，实现了语音对语音翻译，情感语音聊天，交互式播客，以及表达式音频书解说等应用，从而推动语音交互技术的界限。 Demos可在https://fun-audio-llm.github.io上查阅，该代码可在https://github.com/FunAudioLLM上查阅。

items.detail: Producing long-form videos from narration requires interdependent decisions that remain coherent across shots. Existing agentic editors often use multi-stage workflows driven by general models, leaving the quality-cost trade-off of compact, task-adapted policies unclear. We address this gap with WeVisCut, a long-form script-to-video system that connects tool execution with policy learning. Its agent harness maintains shared production state so that tool feedback informs subsequent decisions and repairs. Because finished videos do not expose these decisions, our four-stage data pipeline combines editing inversion with verified replay to turn recovered editing intent into executable supervision. Applied to 3,750 finished videos, this pipeline yields over 130K training examples. We use this supervision to train a single 9B policy that coordinates production and recovers from failures within the same harness. Moreover, we introduce a 100-task benchmark and five metrics assessing editing quality and delivery reliability. Under a shared tool environment, WeVisCut substantially outperforms its base model and achieves comparable performance to Claude Opus 5 while using nearly 33x fewer generated tokens per successful output minute. It also outperforms task-matched native editors on our proposed metrics.
items.title_zh: WeVisCut：一个代理编辑室 从叙述到长相视频
items.detail_zh: 从叙述中制作长式录像需要互相依存的决定，这些决定在镜头中始终一致。现有的代理编辑经常使用由一般模式驱动的多阶段工作流程，使得紧凑，任务调整后的政策的质量成本权衡不明确。我们与WeVisCut解决了这一空白，WeVisCut是一个将工具执行与政策学习联系起来的长式脚本到视频系统。其代理机能保持了共享的生产状态，从而使工具反馈为随后的决定和修理提供参考。因为完成的视频不会暴露这些决定，所以我们的四相数据管道将编辑倒置与经核实的重放相结合，将恢复的编辑意图转化为可执行的监督。该管道对3 750个完成的视频进行了应用，产生了130多起培训案例。我们利用这种监督来训练一种单一的9B政策，协调生产，从同一管子内的故障中恢复过来。此外，我们采用了100个任务基准和5个衡量标准，以评估编辑质量和交付可靠性。在共享工具环境下，WeVisCut的性能大大超过其基础模型，并实现了与克洛德·奥普斯5的可比较性能，同时每成功输出分钟使用近33x更少的生成令牌。它还比我们拟议衡量标准上的任务相称的本地编辑要好。

items.detail: Well-designed prompts are crucial for enhancing Large language models' (LLMs) reasoning capabilities while aligning their outputs with task requirements across diverse domains. However, manually designed prompts require expertise and iterative experimentation. While existing prompt optimization methods aim to automate this process, they rely heavily on external references such as ground truth or by humans, limiting their applicability in real-world scenarios where such data is unavailable or costly to obtain. To address this, we propose Self-Supervised Prompt Optimization (SPO), a cost-efficient framework that discovers effective prompts for both closed and open-ended tasks without requiring external reference. Motivated by the observations that prompt quality manifests directly in LLM outputs and LLMs can effectively assess adherence to task requirements, we derive evaluation and optimization signals purely from output comparisons. Specifically, SPO selects superior prompts through pairwise output comparisons evaluated by an LLM evaluator, followed by an LLM optimizer that aligns outputs with task requirements. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SPO outperforms state-of-the-art prompt optimization methods, achieving comparable or superior results with significantly lower costs (e.g., 1.1% to 5.6% of existing methods) and fewer samples (e.g., three samples). The code is available at https://github.com/geekan/MetaGPT.
items.title_zh: 自控快速优化
items.detail_zh: 精心设计的提示对于加强大语言模型的推理能力至关重要，同时使其产出符合不同领域的任务要求。然而，人工设计的提示需要专门知识和迭代实验。虽然现有的即时优化方法旨在使这一进程自动化，但它们严重依赖外部参考，例如地面真理或人类的参考，从而限制了这些参考方法在缺乏这类数据或获取这类数据费用高昂的现实世界情景中的适用性。为了解决这个问题，我们提议自我监督的即时优化(SPO)，这是一个成本效益高的框架，可以发现既可以完成封闭的任务，也可以完成开放式的任务，而不需要外部参考。我们的动机是，及时的质量直接体现在LLM产出中，而LLM能够有效地评估对任务要求的遵守情况，因此，我们纯粹通过产出比较得出评价和优化信号。具体来说，SPO通过由LLM评价员评价的对等输出比较来选择上等提示，然后选择LLM优化器，使输出符合任务要求。广泛的实验表明，SPO优于最先进的即时优化方法，取得可比或优异的结果，成本大幅降低(例如现有方法的1.1%至5.6%)并减少样本(例如三个样本)。该代码可在https://github.com/geekan/MetaGPT上查阅。

items.detail: We introduce Moshi, a speech-text foundation model and full-duplex spoken dialogue framework. Current systems for spoken dialogue rely on pipelines of independent components, namely voice activity detection, speech recognition, textual dialogue and text-to-speech. Such frameworks cannot emulate the experience of real conversations. First, their complexity induces a latency of several seconds between interactions. Second, text being the intermediate modality for dialogue, non-linguistic information that modifies meaning -- such as emotion or non-speech sounds -- is lost in the interaction. Finally, they rely on a segmentation into speaker turns, which does not take into account overlapping speech, interruptions and interjections. Moshi solves these independent issues altogether by casting spoken dialogue as speech-to-speech generation. Starting from a text language model backbone, Moshi generates speech as tokens from the residual quantizer of a neural audio codec, while modeling separately its own speech and that of the user into parallel streams. This allows for the removal of explicit speaker turns, and the modeling of arbitrary conversational dynamics. We moreover extend the hierarchical semantic-to-acoustic token generation of previous work to first predict time-aligned text tokens as a prefix to audio tokens. Not only this "Inner Monologue" method significantly improves the linguistic quality of generated speech, but we also illustrate how it can provide streaming speech recognition and text-to-speech. Our resulting model is the first real-time full-duplex spoken large language model, with a theoretical latency of 160ms, 200ms in practice, and is available at https://github.com/kyutai-labs/moshi.
items.title_zh: Moshi：实时对话的语音文本基础模型
items.detail_zh: 我们介绍莫希语，一个语音文字基础模型和完全繁复的口头对话框架。目前的口头对话系统依靠独立组成部分的管道，即语音活动检测、语音识别、文字对话和文字对语音。这种框架不能模仿真正对话的经验。首先，它们的复杂性在相互作用之间引起几秒钟的延迟。第二，文本是对话的中间模式，在互动中丢失了修改含义的非语言信息 -- -- 如情感或非语音声音。最后，他们依靠分化为发言转弯，这并没有考虑到发言、中断和插话的重叠。莫希通过将口语对话设定为对口语一代来解决这些独立的问题。从文字语言模型骨干开始，莫希从神经音频编码器的剩余量子中生成语音作为符号，同时将自己的语音和用户的语音分别建模成平行流。这使得可以删除显式的扬声器转动，以及任意对话动态的模型化。此外，我们扩展了前作的等级语义对音符号的生成，首先预测时间对应的文本符号作为音频符号的前缀。不仅这种"内单词"方法大大提高了生成的语音的语言质量，我们还说明了它如何能够提供流传的语音识别和文字对语音。我们由此形成的模式是第一个实时的全方位的大型口语模式，理论延迟160ms，实践200ms，可在https://github.com/kyutai-labs/moshi上查阅。

items.detail: The rapidly growing demand for high-quality data in Large Language Models (LLMs) has intensified the need for scalable, reliable, and semantically rich data preparation pipelines. However, current practices remain dominated by ad-hoc scripts and loosely specified workflows, which lack principled abstractions, hinder reproducibility, and offer limited support for model-in-the-loop data generation. To address these challenges, we present DataFlow, a unified and extensible LLM-driven data preparation framework. DataFlow is designed with system-level abstractions that enable modular, reusable, and composable data transformations, and provides a PyTorch-style pipeline construction API for building debuggable and optimizable dataflows. The framework consists of nearly 200 reusable operators and six domain-general pipelines spanning text, mathematical reasoning, code, Text-to-SQL, agentic RAG, and large-scale knowledge extraction. To further improve usability, we introduce DataFlow-Agent, which automatically translates natural-language specifications into executable pipelines via operator synthesis, pipeline planning, and iterative verification. Across six representative use cases, DataFlow consistently improves downstream LLM performance. Our math, code, and text pipelines outperform curated human datasets and specialized synthetic baselines, achieving up to +3\% execution accuracy in Text-to-SQL over SynSQL, +7\% average improvements on code benchmarks, and 1--3 point gains on MATH, GSM8K, and AIME. Moreover, a unified 10K-sample dataset produced by DataFlow enables base models to surpass counterparts trained on 1M Infinity-Instruct data. These results demonstrate that DataFlow provides a practical and high-performance substrate for reliable, reproducible, and scalable LLM data preparation, and establishes a system-level foundation for future data-centric AI development.
items.title_zh: DataFlow：数据科学AI时代统一数据编制和工作流程自动化的LLM-Driven框架
items.detail_zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)对高质量数据的需求迅速增加，因此更加需要可扩展、可靠和精密的数据编制管道。然而，目前的做法仍然以临时的脚本和松散地指定的工作流程为主，这些工作流程缺乏原则性抽象，阻碍可复制性，并且对即时数据模型生成提供了有限的支持。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了“数据流”，一个统一和可扩展的LLM驱动数据编制框架。 DataFlow采用系统级抽象设计，可实现模块化，可再用和可堆叠的数据转换，并提供PyTorch风格的管道构造 API用于构建可调试和可选择的数据流。该框架包括近200个可重复使用的操作员和6个域通管，跨越文本，数学推理，代码，文本到SQL，代理RAG，以及大规模的知识提取。为了进一步提高可用性，我们引入了"DataFlow-Agent"(DataFlow-Agent)，通过运营商合成，管道规划和迭代验证，自动将自然语言规格翻译为可执行管线。在六个有代表性的使用案例中，DataFlow持续改善下游的LLM性能。我们的数学、代码和文本管道比人类数据集和专门的合成基线要好，在文本到SQL的执行精度高于SynSQL， +7+在代码基准上的平均改进，以及MATH、GSM8K和AIME上的1-3分增益。此外，由DataFlow制作的统一10K-抽样数据集使基础模型能够超越接受过1M无穷指令数据培训的对应数据。这些结果表明，"DataFlow"为可靠，可再生，可扩展的LLM数据编制提供了实用而高性能的底板，为未来以数据为中心的AI开发奠定了系统层面的基础。

items.title: MediaPipe: A Framework for Building Perception Pipelines
items.subtitle: Building applications that perceive the world around them is challenging. items.detail: Building applications that perceive the world around them is challenging. A developer needs to (a) select and develop corresponding machine learning algorithms and models, (b) build a series of prototypes and demos, (c) balance resource consumption against the quality of the solutions, and finally (d) identify and mitigate problematic cases. The MediaPipe framework addresses all of these challenges. A developer can use MediaPipe to build prototypes by combining existing perception components, to advance them to polished cross-platform applications and measure system performance and resource consumption on target platforms. We show that these features enable a developer to focus on the algorithm or model development and use MediaPipe as an environment for iteratively improving their application with results reproducible across different devices and platforms. MediaPipe will be open-sourced at https://github.com/google/mediapipe.
items.title_zh: MediaPipe：建设认知管道的框架
items.detail_zh: 建立能感知周围世界的应用是具有挑战性的。开发者需要(a) 选择和开发相应的机器学习算法和模型，(b) 建立一系列原型和演示，(c) 平衡资源消耗与解决方案质量，最后(d) 发现并缓解有问题的案例。 MediaPipe框架处理所有这些挑战。一个开发者可以使用MediaPipe通过将现有的感知组件组合起来来构建原型，以推进它们来抛光跨平台的应用程序并测量目标平台的系统性能和资源消耗。我们显示，这些特性使开发者能够专注于算法或模型开发，并使用MediaPipe作为环境来反复改进它们的应用，其结果可以在不同设备和平台上复制。 MediaPipe将在https://github.com/google/mediapipe上开源。

items.detail: Agents built on vision language models (VLMs) now compete with learned policies on robot manipulation leaderboards. We ask how far a coding agent can go when it controls a robot instead of a computer, and where it stops. Our system, HexaShell, keeps the harness thin: it only turns the agent's commands into robot motion. The agent drives a robot with two arms through one command line. It sees three RGB cameras and knows their calibration. After each failed attempt, the agent reads the log, finds the cause, and writes or fixes small programs called tools. In this way it keeps what it learns as code, as a coding agent does when it fixes a failing test. The tools may use only what the robot observes. They use triangulation to find where objects are, relative to each other and to the gripper. If two cameras see the same point, the point lies where the two camera rays meet. If a point lies on a known plane, such as the table or the top of a block, it lies where its ray meets that plane. When the head camera is not enough, the robot moves a wrist camera to get a second view. We build the tools on only ten layouts of one seed per task, then freeze them and test them on ten new layouts of the same seed. We use Codex with GPT-6-Astra at medium reasoning effort. On all 42 RoboDojo tasks, HexaShell reaches a success rate of 39.7% and a progress score of 48.0, averaged in the same way as the leaderboard. This is a new state of the art on RoboDojo. The limit is contact, not reasoning: pushing reaches 92.5% and memory tasks 65.0%, but tight insertion only 8.3%. When the agent fails, it usually sees the failure but cannot make the motion work. We open source the tools evolved so far at https://github.com/HexaFuture/HexaShell.
items.title_zh: 六舍尔：探索作为机器人编码代理的VLM代理的极限的微弱优势
items.detail_zh: 以视觉语言模型(VLMs)为基础的代理商现在与关于机器人操纵领导板的学习政策竞争。我们问一个编码代理在控制一个机器人而不是计算机时能走多远，以及它停在哪里。我们的系统，HexaShell，保持了控制：它只会把特工的命令变成机器人的运动。特工驾驶一个双臂机器人通过一个命令行。它看到三台RGB摄像头并知道它们的校准。每次尝试失败后，代理会读取日志，找到原因，并写或修正名为工具的小程序。这样它就能保持它作为代码学到的东西，就像它修复失败测试时的编码代理所做的那样。这些工具可能只使用机器人观察到的东西。它们利用三角测量来寻找物体的位置，相对彼此和捕捉者。如果两台相机看到同一点，则点位于两台相机射线相遇的地方。如果一个点位于已知的平面上，如桌子或块的顶部，它就位于它的射线与该平面相遇的地方。当头摄像头不够时，机器人会移动手腕摄像头以获得第二个视图。我们每件任务只用一个种子的十种布局来建造工具，然后将其冻结，并在同一个种子的十种新布局上进行测试。我们在中度推理过程中使用GPT-6-Astra的Codex。在所有42项RoboDojo任务中，HexoShell都取得了39.7%的成功率，进步分48.0的平均成绩与领跑板相同。这是关于RoboDojo的新艺术 极限是接触，而不是推理：推力达到92.5%，内存任务达到65.0%，但紧插入率只有8.3%。当代理失败时，它通常会看到失败但不能使运动发挥作用。我们开放了迄今在https://github.com/HexaFuture/HexaShell上演变的工具来源。

items.detail: We present the Flavors of Moonshine, a suite of tiny automatic speech recognition (ASR) models specialized for a range of underrepresented languages. Prevailing wisdom suggests that multilingual ASR models outperform monolingual counterparts by exploiting cross-lingual phonetic similarities. We challenge this assumption, showing that for sufficiently small models (27M parameters), training monolingual systems on a carefully balanced mix of high-quality human-labeled, pseudo-labeled, and synthetic data yields substantially superior performance. On average, our models achieve error rates 48% lower than the comparably sized Whisper Tiny model, outperform the 9x larger Whisper Small model, and in most cases match or outperform the 28x larger Whisper Medium model. These results advance the state of the art for models of this size, enabling accurate on-device ASR for languages that previously had limited support. We release Arabic, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Ukrainian, and Vietnamese Moonshine models under a permissive open-source license.
items.title_zh: Flavors of Moonshine：微小的边缘设备专用ASR模型
items.detail_zh: 我们介绍"月光之花"(Flavors of Moonshine)，这是一套用于各种代表性不足语言的小型自动语音识别(ASR)模型。常用的智慧表明，多语种ASR模型通过利用跨语言的语音相似性，优于单一语言的对应模型。我们质疑这一假设，表明对于足够小的模型(27M参数)，对单一语言系统进行关于高质量的人类标签、伪标签和合成数据的精心平衡组合的培训，其性能相当好。平均来说，我们的模型比可比较大小的Whisper Tiny模型实现48%的出错率，优于9x大Whisper Small模型，在多数情况下与28x大Whisper MED模型相匹配或优于。这些结果推进了这种大小的模型的艺术状态，使得以前支持有限的语言能够准确的进行ASR。我们发布阿拉伯文、中文、日文、韩文、乌克兰文和越南的月光模型，

items.detail: This report presents VibeVoice, a novel model designed to synthesize long-form speech with multiple speakers by employing next-token diffusion, which is a unified method for modeling continuous data by autoregressively generating latent vectors via diffusion. To enable this, we introduce a novel continuous speech tokenizer that, when compared to the popular Encodec model, improves data compression by 80 times while maintaining comparable performance. The tokenizer effectively preserves audio fidelity while significantly boosting computational efficiency for processing long sequences. Thus, VibeVoice can synthesize long-form speech for up to 90 minutes (in a 64K context window length) with a maximum of 4 speakers, capturing the authentic conversational ``vibe'' and surpassing open-source and proprietary dialogue models.
items.detail_zh: 本报告介绍了VibeVoice，这是一种新颖的模型，旨在通过使用近位传播来合成长式语音和多位扬声器，这是一种通过传播自旋生成潜在向量来模拟连续数据的统一方法。为了实现这一点，我们引入了一种新颖的连续语音表示器，与流行的Encodec模型相比，在保持可比性能的同时将数据压缩提高了80倍。标语器有效地保存了音频忠贞性，同时大大提高了处理长序列的计算效率。因此，VibeVoice可以合成最长90分钟的长式语音(在64K上下文窗口长度)，最多4个扬声器，捕捉真实的对白"vibe'，并超越开源和专有的对话模式。

items.title: Moonshine: Speech Recognition for Live Transcription and Voice Commands
items.subtitle: This paper introduces Moonshine, a family of speech recognition models optimized for live transcription and voice command processing. Moonshine is based on an encoder-decoder transformer architecture and employs Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) instead of traditional absolute position embeddings. The model is trained on speech segments of various lengths, but without using zero-padding, leading to greater efficiency for the encoder during inference time. items.detail: This paper introduces Moonshine, a family of speech recognition models optimized for live transcription and voice command processing. Moonshine is based on an encoder-decoder transformer architecture and employs Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) instead of traditional absolute position embeddings. The model is trained on speech segments of various lengths, but without using zero-padding, leading to greater efficiency for the encoder during inference time. When benchmarked against OpenAI's Whisper tiny.en, Moonshine Tiny demonstrates a 5x reduction in compute requirements for transcribing a 10-second speech segment while incurring no increase in word error rates across standard evaluation datasets. These results highlight Moonshine's potential for real-time and resource-constrained applications.
items.title_zh: Moonshine：现场转写和语音命令的语音识别
items.detail_zh: 本文引入了"月光"(Moonshine)，一个最优化的语音识别模式家族，用于现场抄录和语音指令处理。 Moonshine基于一个编码器-解码器变压器架构，并使用Rotary Place Embedding(ROPE)而不是传统的绝对位置嵌入。该模型在各种长度的语音段上都经过了培训，但没有使用"零平板"，导致在推想期间编码器效率更高。当以 OpenAI 的 Whisper tiny.en 为基准时，Moonshine Tiny 显示，对转录10秒语音段的计算要求减少了5x，同时在标准评价数据集中不发生字数错误率的增加。这些结果凸显出"月光"在实时和资源受限应用方面的潜力。

items.detail: World models enable embodied agents to anticipate action consequences, yet jointly modeling locomotion and manipulation across diverse embodiments remains challenging due to heterogeneous action spaces and limited multimodal supervision. We present Ropedia W0, the first egocentric loco-manipulation world foundation model spanning humans and robots with diverse embodiments. We curate Xp-Data, comprising 10k hours of egocentric human data and 3k hours of robot data with unified multimodal annotations and systematic quality control. A unified kinematic representation encodes locomotion through camera poses and manipulation through projected skeletons, with robot skeletons combining embodiment-specific forward kinematics with extensive manual keypoint annotation and correction. We also introduce Xp-Teleop, a long-horizon loco-manipulation benchmark based on high-quality dexterous humanoid teleoperation data. Evaluations demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across five cross-embodiment benchmarks (DreamDojo, Ψ_0, ω-HOME, Xp-Teleop, and AgiBot) and on held-out human egocentric video, from zero-shot inference to few-shot and full-data post-training. Scaling human pre-training data improves performance on both human and robot evaluations. After distillation, our model supports real-time, minute-long rollouts, enabling live VR interaction. Applications in policy evaluation, model-based planning, and world-action modeling further demonstrate the model's utility for embodied decision-making.
items.title_zh: Ropedia W0：利用人类经验在安徽推广Loco-Manipulation世界模式
items.detail_zh: 世界模式使体现的代理人能够预见到行动的后果，但是，由于行动空间各异和多式联运监督有限，在各种表现形式上联合模拟运动和操纵仍然具有挑战性。我们介绍Ropedia W0，这是第一个以自我为中心 游戏操控世界的基础模型，覆盖了人类和机器人，并有着不同的化身。我们管理Xp-Data，包括10k小时的自我中心人类数据和3k小时的机器人数据，并附有统一的多式联运说明和系统的质量控制。统一的动能表现编码通过相机摆设和操纵通过投影骨架进行运动，机器人骨架将浮雕特异性前动能与广泛的手动键点注释和校正相结合。我们还采用了Xp-Teleop，这是一个基于高质量脱氧核糖核酸人电动操作数据的长视离子操纵基准。评估显示，在五个交叉表现基准(DreamDojo、XΨ 0、Xω-HOME、Xp-Teleop和AgiBot)中，以及在从零镜头推论到数镜头和完整数据培训后视频上，表现最先进的表现。扩大人类培训前数据可提高人类和机器人评价的性能。蒸馏后，我们的模型支持实时，一分钟的推出，使VR能够进行现场互动。政策评估、基于模型的规划和世界行动模型方面的应用进一步表明该模型对体现的决策的有用性。

items.detail: We present Hunyuan3D 2.0, an advanced large-scale 3D synthesis system for generating high-resolution textured 3D assets. This system includes two foundation components: a large-scale shape generation model -- Hunyuan3D-DiT, and a large-scale texture synthesis model -- Hunyuan3D-Paint. The shape generative model, built on a scalable flow-based diffusion transformer, aims to create geometry that properly aligns with a given condition image, laying a solid foundation for downstream applications. The texture synthesis model, benefiting from strong geometric and diffusion priors, produces high-resolution and vibrant texture maps for either generated or hand-crafted meshes. Furthermore, we build Hunyuan3D-Studio -- a versatile, user-friendly production platform that simplifies the re-creation process of 3D assets. It allows both professional and amateur users to manipulate or even animate their meshes efficiently. We systematically evaluate our models, showing that Hunyuan3D 2.0 outperforms previous state-of-the-art models, including the open-source models and closed-source models in geometry details, condition alignment, texture quality, and etc. Hunyuan3D 2.0 is publicly released in order to fill the gaps in the open-source 3D community for large-scale foundation generative models. The code and pre-trained weights of our models are available at: https://github.com/Tencent/Hunyuan3D-2
items.title_zh: Hunyuan3D 2.0：高分辨率文本化3D资产生成放大扩散模型
items.detail_zh: 我们介绍Hunyuan3D 2.0，一个先进的大型3D合成系统，用于生成高分辨率的文本化3D资产。这个系统包括两个基础组件：一个大规模形状生成模型-Hunyuan3D-DiT，一个大规模纹理合成模型-Hunyuan3D-Paint。造型基因模型建立在可伸缩的流基扩散变速器上，旨在创建与特定条件图像适当对齐的几何学，为下游应用奠定了坚实的基础。纹理合成模型得益于强几何和传播前科，为生成的或手工制作的网盖制作高分辨率和充满活力的纹理图。此外，我们建造了Hunyuan3D-Studio -- -- 一个多功能、方便用户的生产平台，简化了3D资产的再创造过程。它使专业和业余用户能够有效地操纵甚至激活他们的网格。我们系统地评价我们的模型，显示Hunyuan3D 2.0比以前最先进的模型表现得更好，包括几何细节，条件一致，纹理质量等方面的开源模型和闭源模型。 Hunyuan3D 2.0公开发布，以填补开源3D社区中用于大型基础基因模型的空白。我们的模型的代码和预先训练的权重可在以下网址查阅：https://github.com/Tencent/Hunyuan3D-2

items.detail: Long-horizon video generation requires models to effectively leverage an increasingly long generation history. As the generated history grows, retaining all previous content becomes increasingly expensive and redundant, making effective historical selection essential. Existing approaches often determine historical relevance based on the current content. However, information relevant to the present is not necessarily useful for future generation, while seemingly less relevant history may become important later. Our key insight is that historical information should be selected according to its relevance to future information needs. Capturing these needs does not require generating the full future; instead, a compact representation of what becomes important next is sufficient to guide historical selection. Building on this insight, we propose FrameMorrow, a prospective frame selector that predicts a small set of prospective tokens representing future information needs and uses them to identify relevant information from history. FrameMorrow selects explicit historical frames rather than model-specific internal states, enabling plug-and-play integration across diverse generators, including closed-source models, with little additional inference cost. We evaluate FrameMorrow across five benchmarks and 11 generative models spanning long-video generation, interactive generation, and action-conditioned world models. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in long-range consistency, visual quality, and action alignment across diverse generation settings.
items.title_zh: FrameMorrow：未来指导框架选择，并带有可视的Tokens用于长视视频生成
items.detail_zh: 长视视频生成需要模型来有效地利用越来越长的一代历史。随着所产生历史的不断增长，保留所有以前的内容变得越来越昂贵和多余，因此有效的历史选择必不可少。现有办法往往根据现有内容确定历史相关性。然而，与目前有关的资料不一定对后世有用，而似乎不太相关的历史在后世可能变得重要。我们的主要见解是，历史信息应根据其与未来信息需要的相关性加以选择。抓住这些需要并不要求创造出完整的未来；相反，紧凑地表述出今后的重要内容足以指导历史选择。基于这一见解，我们提议FrameMorrow，一个预测未来信号的预选框架选择器，它预示着代表未来信息需要的一小组预想信号，并利用它们来识别历史中的相关信息。 FrameMorrow选择了明确的历史框架，而不是模型特定的内部状态，使得插值和游戏集成能够跨出包括闭源模型在内的各种发电机，几乎没有额外的推论成本。我们通过五个基准和11个基因模型来评估框架未来，这些模型包括长视频生成、互动生成和有条件行动的世界模型。广泛的实验表明，在不同世代环境中，在远程一致性、视觉质量和行动一致性方面，不断改进。

items.detail: As streaming video generation advances, enabling real-time interaction with generated video is becoming increasingly important. We introduce StreamEval, a unified benchmark for interactive streaming video generation spanning five tasks: avatar dialogue, avatar performance, world generation, instruction editing, and reference editing. StreamEval comprises 300 scripted test cases lasting 15-300s, each specifying initial assets, incrementally arriving multimodal requests, and explicit requirements for state changes and content preservation. Performance is assessed along four evaluation dimensions: task execution, state consistency, visual fidelity, and audiovisual coordination, instantiated through ten task-specific metrics on a 0-100 scale. Evaluating 37 distinct models across 300 test cases, we find that high visual quality and identity retention do not necessarily coincide with reliable request execution or sustained state consistency. In particular, request execution remains challenging: the highest task-specific scores are 36.90 for Following among seven avatar-performance models, 25.93 for Following in text-conditioned world generation, and 15.00 for Edit Success among three reported reference-editing models. These findings identify reliable request execution under timing and preservation constraints as a central challenge for advancing omni-modal real-time interactive systems. The leaderboard is available at https://streameval.ai
items.title_zh: StreamEval：评价互动流视频生成模式
items.detail_zh: 随着流媒体视频生成的进步，与生成的视频进行实时互动变得越来越重要。我们引入了 StreamEval，用于交互流视频生成的统一基准，涉及五项任务：avatar对话、avatar性能、世界生成、指令编辑和参考编辑。 StreamEval包括300个脚本测试案例，持续15-300小时，每个案例都具体说明初始资产，递增收到的多式联运请求，以及国家变更和内容保存的明确要求。业绩按四个评价方面来评估：任务执行、状态一致性、视觉忠诚和视听协调，通过10项具体任务衡量标准在0-100尺度上进行即时评估。在对300个测试案件中的37个不同模型进行评估后，我们发现，高视觉质量和保留身份并不一定与可靠的请求执行或持续的国家一致性相吻合。特别是，执行请求仍然具有挑战性：在7个阿凡达性能模型中，任务特有分数最高的是36.90分，在文本条件世界一代中，为25.93分，在三个报告参考编辑模型中，为15.00分。这些结论确定，在时间安排和保全限制下可靠地执行请求，是推进全方位实时互动系统的中心挑战。领导牌可在https://streameval.ai上查阅。

items.detail: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable potential as autonomous agents, approaching human-expert performance through advanced reasoning and tool orchestration. However, decision-making in fully dynamic and live environments remains highly challenging, requiring real-time information integration and adaptive responses. While existing efforts have explored live evaluation mechanisms in structured tasks, a critical gap remains in systematic benchmarking for real-world applications, particularly in finance where stringent requirements exist for live strategic responsiveness. To address this gap, we introduce AI-Trader, the first fully-automated, live, and data-uncontaminated evaluation benchmark for LLM agents in financial decision-making. AI-Trader spans three major financial markets: U.S. stocks, A-shares, and cryptocurrencies, with multiple trading granularities to simulate live financial environments. Our benchmark implements a revolutionary fully autonomous minimal information paradigm where agents receive only essential context and must independently search, verify, and synthesize live market information without human intervention. We evaluate six mainstream LLMs across three markets and multiple trading frequencies. Our analysis reveals striking findings: general intelligence does not automatically translate to effective trading capability, with most agents exhibiting poor returns and weak risk management. We demonstrate that risk control capability determines cross-market robustness, and that AI trading strategies achieve excess returns more readily in highly liquid markets than policy-driven environments. These findings expose critical limitations in current autonomous agents and provide clear directions for future improvements. The code and evaluation data are open-sourced to foster community research: https://github.com/HKUDS/AI-Trader.
items.title_zh: AI-Trader：实时金融市场自主代理基准
items.detail_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)表现出了作为自主代理的显著潜力，通过先进的推理和工具的管弦来接近人类-专家的性能。然而，在充满活力的现场环境中作出决策仍然极具挑战性，需要实时信息整合和适应性反应。虽然现有努力在结构化任务中探索了现场评价机制，但在对现实世界的应用进行系统衡量方面仍然存在重大差距，特别是在资金方面，因为对于现场战略反应能力有严格的要求。为了弥补这一差距，我们采用了AI-Trader，这是财务决策中第一个完全自动化、实时和未受数据污染的LLM剂评价基准。 AI-Trader跨越三大金融市场：美国股票，A股，和密码，有多个交易颗粒以模拟活的金融环境。我们的基准执行一种革命性、完全自主的最低限度信息范式，即代理人只接受基本环境，必须独立搜索、核实和综合市场实况信息，而无需人类干预。我们评估了三个市场和多个交易频率的六个主流有限责任公司。我们的分析揭示了惊人的结论：一般情报不会自动转化为有效的贸易能力，大多数代理人的回报不佳，风险管理薄弱。我们表明，风险控制能力决定了跨市场的稳健性，AI贸易战略比政策驱动的环境更容易在高流动性市场实现超额回报。这些调查结果暴露了目前自主代理机构的关键局限性，为今后的改进提供了明确的方向。代码和评价数据开源，以促进社区研究：https://github.com/HKUDS/AI-Trader。

items.detail: Latent generative models typically follow a two-stage pipeline, training a variational autoencoder for reconstruction and then a generative model on the frozen latent space. Since reconstruction-optimized latents are not necessarily generation-friendly, jointly training both models is an appealing alternative. However, direct end-to-end training remains challenging, as it is prone to latent collapse and faces a generation-reconstruction conflict. We revisit this problem by analyzing how different objectives shape the latent space and identify two key insights. First, the entropy term in the Kullback-Leibler divergence objective is essential for preventing collapse: reconstruction and prior fitting tend to shrink the posterior, while entropy preserves non-degenerate latent uncertainty. Second, reconstruction and generation exhibit asymmetric learning dynamics: reconstruction is fast and strongly supervised, whereas generation is slower and harder to optimize. Based on these insights, we achieve the first direct end-to-end training without latent collapse and propose GenFirst, a simple generation-before-reconstruction strategy. The generative objective first shapes the latent space under weak reconstruction pressure, after which reconstruction is progressively strengthened to recover visual details. We validate GenFirst with continuous autoregressive priors with exact likelihoods and SiT priors with implicit likelihoods. With our end-to-end objective and GenFirst, SiT achieves a gFID of 0.97 with CFG and 1.45 without CFG on ImageNet-256, while MMDiT reaches a GenEval score of 0.90 on text-to-image generation. Beyond image generation, we extend the framework to shared visual latents for generation and representation learning, and to continuous unified text-image generation. These results demonstrate the generality of stable end-to-end latent learning across generative priors and modalities.
items.title_zh: Gen First：重建前的生成，用于稳定后期到后期的基因模型
items.detail_zh: 后期基因模型一般遵循两个阶段的管道，培训用于重建的可变自编码器，然后在被冻结的潜在空间上培养出基因模型。由于优化重建的潜力不一定有利于一代人，因此联合培训两种模式都是一种有吸引力的选择。然而，直接的端到端培训仍然具有挑战性，因为它容易发生潜在的崩溃并面临一代人重建冲突。我们通过分析不同目标如何塑造潜在空间并找出两个关键见解来重新审视这一问题。首先，Kullback-Leibler分解目标中的等离子词对于防止倒塌至关重要：重建与前置往往会收缩后方，而等离子则保留了非再生的潜在不确定性。第二，重建和一代展现出不对称的学习动态：重建速度快，受到强有力的监督，而一代人更慢，更难优化。基于这些见解，我们实现了第一个没有潜在倒塌的直接端到端训练，并提出了GenFirst，一个简单的一代再重建战略。基因目标首先在薄弱的重建压力下塑造出潜在的空间，之后重建被逐步加强以恢复视觉细节。我们验证GenFirst 连续的自旋前传 准确的可能性和SIT前传 隐含的可能性。随着我们的端到端目标和GenFirst，SiT在CFG上实现了0.97的GFID，在ImageNet-256上实现了1.45的CFG，而MMdiT在文本到图像生成上达到了0.90的GenEval分。除了图像生成之外，我们还将框架扩展到共同的视觉潜力，用于生成和表现学习，以及持续的统一的文本图像生成。这些结果表明，不同遗传学前科和模式之间稳定、端到端的潜在学习是普遍的。

items.detail: Large Language Models (LLMs) have become an essential infrastructure for Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), yet their lack of well-defined memory management systems hinders the development of long-context reasoning, continual personalization, and knowledge consistency.Existing models mainly rely on static parameters and short-lived contextual states, limiting their ability to track user preferences or update knowledge over extended periods.While Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) introduces external knowledge in plain text, it remains a stateless workaround without lifecycle control or integration with persistent representations.Recent work has modeled the training and inference cost of LLMs from a memory hierarchy perspective, showing that introducing an explicit memory layer between parameter memory and external retrieval can substantially reduce these costs by externalizing specific knowledge. Beyond computational efficiency, LLMs face broader challenges arising from how information is distributed over time and context, requiring systems capable of managing heterogeneous knowledge spanning different temporal scales and sources. To address this challenge, we propose MemOS, a memory operating system that treats memory as a manageable system resource. It unifies the representation, scheduling, and evolution of plaintext, activation-based, and parameter-level memories, enabling cost-efficient storage and retrieval. As the basic unit, a MemCube encapsulates both memory content and metadata such as provenance and versioning. MemCubes can be composed, migrated, and fused over time, enabling flexible transitions between memory types and bridging retrieval with parameter-based learning. MemOS establishes a memory-centric system framework that brings controllability, plasticity, and evolvability to LLMs, laying the foundation for continual learning and personalized modeling.
items.title_zh: MemOS：AI系统的内存OS
items.detail_zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)已经成为人工一般智能(AGI)的基本基础设施，然而它们缺乏定义明确的内存管理系统，阻碍了长语推理，持续的个性化和知识一致性的发展。现有的模型主要依靠静态参数和短寿命的上下文状态，限制了它们在长时间内跟踪用户偏好或更新知识的能力。虽然检索-增强的一代(RAG)以简洁的文字介绍外部知识，但它仍然是无国籍的工作，没有生命周期控制或与持续表述相结合。最近的工作从内存结构的角度模拟了LLMs的培训和推导成本，表明在参数内存和外部检索之间引入一个明确的内存层，通过将特定知识外部化，可以大大减少这些成本。除了计算效率之外，法学硕士课程还面临因信息如何在时间和背景上分布而产生的更广泛的挑战，需要能够管理跨越不同时间尺度和来源的多样化知识的系统。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出MemOS，一种将内存视为可管理系统资源的内存操作系统。它统一了纯文本、基于激活的记忆和参数级记忆的表达、时间安排和演变，从而能够以具有成本效益的方式存储和检索。作为基本单元，一个MemCube同时封装内存内容和元数据，如出处和版本。元立方体可以随时间而组成，迁移，并被熔化，使得内存类型和以参数为基础的学习连接检索之间能够灵活过渡。 MemOS建立了一个以记忆为中心的系统框架，为LLMs带来可控性，可塑性和可转性，为持续学习和个性化建模奠定了基础。

items.title: Nutlope/hallmark
items.subtitle: Anti-AI-slop design skill for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.
items.detail: A design skill for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode that refuses to look AI-generated. usehallmark.com · fifty themes · custom on request · redesign and audit by name Hallmark holds a hard floor and then gets out of the way. It deals three themes from a catalog of fifty materials, builds the page around what the visitor came to do, and lints the result in a real browser against the tells that read as machine-made: the eyebrow above every heading, tracked-capital labels, one coloured word in a headline, a page of empty frames or nothing but photographs, a hero that misses its screen, an email sign-up at the end of every page, a form that says thanks without sending anything. A fresh-context reviewer gets the last word.
items.detail_zh: Claude Code， Codex， Cursor和OpenCode的设计技巧，拒绝外观AI生成。使用hallmark.com (英语)。 · 重新设计和审计Hallmark的名字。它从一个包含50个材料的目录中处理出三个主题，围绕访问者来做的事情构建一页，并用一个真实的浏览器将结果与被读作机器制作的剧情相对照：每个标题上方的眉毛，有追踪的资本标签，头条上一个有彩色的字，一页空框或只是照片，一个错过屏幕的英雄，每个页的结尾有电子邮件的签注，一个不发送任何东西就表示感谢的表格。新语录评论员获得最后一句话。

items.title: pingdotgg/t3code
items.detail: T3 Code is an "agent harness control surface". It enables control of the agents on your machine with a best-in-class mobile app (iOS, Android), web app and Electron-based desktop app. Works with your subscriptions on Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Build, OpenCode, and Google Antigravity. If they're set up on your computer, T3 Code can control them. Nothing. We built T3 Code because we wanted the best possible development experience with agents. We were inspired by existing solutions like the Codex desktop app, Conductor, Claude Desktop and Cursor Glass, but none met our bar.
items.detail_zh: T3代码是"特工控制带表面"。它通过一个最上等的移动应用(iOS，Android)，网络应用和以Electron为基础的桌面应用来控制您机器上的代理。与你的订阅 克劳德代码， Codex， Cursor， Grok Building， OpenCode，和谷歌反重力。如果它们被安装在你的电脑上，T3代码可以控制它们。没什么 我们建立了T3代码，因为我们想要最好的开发经验 与代理。我们受到诸如Codex桌面应用程序、导师、克洛德桌面和光电玻璃等现有解决方案的启发，但都没有遇到我们的酒吧。

items.title: obra/superpowers
items.subtitle: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
items.detail: Superpowers is a complete software development methodology for your coding agents, built on top of a set of composable skills and some initial instructions that make sure your agent uses them. It starts from the moment you fire up your coding agent. As soon as it sees that you're building something, it doesn't just jump into trying to write code. Instead, it steps back and asks you what you're really trying to do. Once it's teased a spec out of the conversation, it shows it to you in chunks short enough to actually read and digest.
items.subtitle_zh: 一种有效的代理技能框架和软件开发方法。
items.detail_zh: 超能力(Superpowers)是您编码代理的一种完整的软件开发方法，它建立在一组可堆叠的技能和一些初始指令之上，以确保您的代理使用它们。从你点燃你的编码代理开始 一旦它发现你正在建造某种东西，它就不只是跳跃到试图写代码。相反，它退一步 问你，你到底想做什么。一旦它从对话中取笑了一点，它会用足够短的块来显示它，以实际阅读和消化。

Anthropic's frontend-design was the first widely-used design skill for Claude. Impeccable started from there. Every model trained on the same SaaS templates. Skip the guidance and you get the same handful of tells on every project: Inter for everything, purple-to-blue gradients, cards nested in cards, gray text on colored backgrounds, the rounded-square icon tile above every heading.

items.title: anthropics/skills
items.subtitle: Public repository for Agent Skills
items.detail: Skills are folders of instructions, scripts, and resources that Claude loads dynamically to improve performance on specialized tasks. Skills teach Claude how to complete specific tasks in a repeatable way, whether that's creating documents with your company's brand guidelines, analyzing data using your organization's specific workflows, or automating personal tasks. This repository contains skills that demonstrate what's possible with Claude's skills system. These skills range from creative applications (art, music, design) to technical tasks (testing web apps, MCP server generation) to enterprise workflows (communications, branding, etc.). Each skill is self-contained in its own folder with a SKILL.md file containing the instructions and metadata that Claude uses. Browse through these skills to get inspiration for your own skills or to understand different patterns and approaches.

items.detail_zh: 技能是克劳德动态地加载以提高专业任务性能的指令，脚本和资源的文件夹。技能教克洛德如何以可重复的方式完成具体的任务，无论是用你的公司的品牌准则创建文件，利用你的组织的具体工作流程分析数据，还是将个人任务自动化。这个寄存器包含了能展示克劳德的技能系统所可能具备的技能。这些技能从创意应用(艺术，音乐，设计)到技术任务(测试网络应用，MCP服务器生成)到企业工作流程(通信，品牌等)。每种技能都自成一体地放入自己的文件夹，其中包含克洛德使用的指令和元数据的一个SKILL.md文件。通过这些技能来浏览以获得对自身技能的启发或理解不同的模式和方法。

Ghostty provides all three. libghostty is a cross-platform, zero-dependency C and Zig library for building terminal emulators or utilizing terminal functionality (such as style parsing). See Ghostling for a minimal complete project example or the examples directory for smaller examples of using libghostty in C and Zig. items.title: cloudflare/security-audit-skill
items.subtitle: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
items.detail: A coding-agent skill that turns your agent into a security auditor. It orchestrates isolated agents through reconnaissance, coverage-led hunting, candidate validation, structured output, independent record verification, and target-neutral reporting. This is the skill that seeded Cloudflare's vulnerability discovery harness, described in Build your own vulnerability harness. The harness grew into a multi-stage, fleet-wide system; this skill is the single-repo starting point it evolved from. 1. Reconnaissance -- map architecture, trust boundaries, input surfaces, prior evidence, and deterministic coverage in architecture.md and coverage-ledger.json. 2. Coverage-led hunting -- assign isolated hunters from ledger units, record their checks, and use coverage critics to find gaps. 3. Candidate validation -- give every unique candidate to a fresh verifier that tries to disprove it. 4. Structured output -- write confirmed, needsvalidation, and rejected records to findings.json and validate them against report-schema.json. 5. Independent record verification -- fresh agents verify final source claims. Material replacements receive another independent verifier. 6. Target-neutral reporting -- derive REPORT.md, FINDINGS-DETAIL.md, and NEEDS-VALIDATION.md from the verified records and coverage ledger.
items.subtitle_zh: 分阶段执行安全审计的 Coding Agent Skill：通过架构侦察、覆盖率驱动的缺陷搜索、独立验证和机器可读的发现记录，提高安全审计的可追溯性。
items.detail_zh: 将你的经纪人变成安全审计师的编码技术 它通过侦察、以覆盖为主导的狩猎、候选人验证、结构化产出、独立记录核查以及目标中立的报告，协调孤立的特工。这是Cloudflare的弱点发现工具的种子，在Build自己的弱点工具中描述。牵引力发展成一个多阶段，全舰队范围的系统；这种技能是它从中演化出来的单回波起点。 1。侦察 -- -- 地图结构、信任边界、输入面、先前证据以及架构。md和覆盖-引导器。json的确定性覆盖。 2。覆盖为主的狩猎 -- -- 从分类单元中指派孤立的猎人，记录他们的支票，利用覆盖批评者寻找漏洞。 3。候选人验证 -- -- 将每个独特的候选人交给一个新的核查者，以试图反驳。 4。结构化产出 -- -- 书面确认、需要验证和拒绝对调查结果的记录。 5。独立记录核实 -- -- 新鲜剂核实最终来源声称。物料取代器得到另一个独立的验证器。 6。目标中立的报告 -- -- 从经核实的记录和覆盖分类账中得出报告(m)，FindingS-DETAIL.m和NeedS-Validation.m。

items.detail: Claude Code、Codex、CursorをはじめとするAIコーディング環境に読み込ませて使用してください。本体を入れられない環境のために、本体を短くした yomiyasu-mini と yomiyasu-pocket も公開しています（本体を入れられない環境では）。 文章を生成するAIは日常的な道具となりました。 一方で、AIで生成された文章には独特のクセが残りやすく、そのままでは実務や技術発信に使いにくい場面が多くあります。 1. 禁止語の置き換えにとどまる対処 「手触り」「解像度」「泥臭い」といった表層の単語を禁止しても、別の曖昧な語へ置き換わるだけで、不自然な文構造そのものは解消されませんでした。 2. 編集ルールの過剰適用 修辞の規範を与えすぎると、モデルが指示を過剰に解釈し、かえって不自然な造語や大げさな文体を招いていました。 3. 主述関係の曖昧さと非生物主語 誰が何をどうするのかが省略されたまま、概念や道具が比喩的な動詞（壊れる、倒す、効くなど）と結びつき、読み手が文脈を大きく補って読む必要がありました。 4. 形式の偏重と情報密度の低下 太字や箇条書きが増える一方で、手順やコードの仕組みといった核心の部分は抽象的に書かれ、文章の量に比べて実際の情報が少なくなっていました。

items.badge: GitHub · 新创建 Skills 仓库
items.author: Python
items.detail: Oil UI is an interface design skill for AI agents. It explores a few genuinely different design directions side by side, lets you choose one, then refines it against real screenshots. It works for websites, apps, dashboards, and components. See more designs at ui.oiloil.org. 1. Understand what the product is. Before drawing anything, it names the product category, finds two or three peers with the most distinctive styles, and looks at what they do and why. Then it decides what to keep and what to change. 2. Turn “premium” and “clean” into real decisions. Everyone uses these words, but they don't tell you what to put on the screen. It first sets the tone from the subject, audience, and brand voice, such as lively or calm, polished or raw, dense or airy. Then it turns that tone into visible choices: which typefaces, how much white space, and how much of the page uses color. 3. Start each direction from something concrete. That could be a material in its setting, a scene, a character, or the visual language of another field. Ideas come from the product itself, not from adjectives like “minimal” or “bold.” 4. Decide who the first screen is for. On pages where people browse, shop, or get work done, the first screen should be the content itself. Only pages meant to persuade need a designed opening layout, settled before the copy is written. 5. Make the directions truly different. Of

items.detail: Research Solution Supervisor 是一个面向研究型工作的 AI 监督 skill。它不负责把研究重新做一遍，而是判断 AI 的回答、研究 pass 或方案建议是否真正推进了用户的研究目标，并把结论转成下一步可执行动作。 这个 skill 借鉴了 Intent Debugger 的思路：先把目标和判断标准说清楚，再评估当前输出是否满足这些标准。不同点在于，Intent Debugger 更偏“把模糊意图变成可确认需求”，Research Solution Supervisor 更偏“监督 AI 是否让研究方案真的向前走”。 1. 推进判断：当前 AI 工作是否解决了本阶段问题。 2. 关键缺口：哪些缺失、冲突或证据不足会影响继续推进。 3. 下一步动作：下一轮最该做什么，必要时给出可直接发送的 prompt。 4. 当前状态：哪些可以暂时视为成立，哪些仍然不能依赖。

items.detail_en: Research Solutions Manager is an AI skiller for research-oriented work. It is not responsible for re-examining research, but rather for determining whether AI ' s answers, studies pass or programme recommendations really advance the user ' s research objectives and translates the conclusions into next implementable actions. This skill draws on the idea of Intent Debugger: first, to clarify the objective and the judgement criteria, then to assess whether the current output meets them. The difference is that the Intent Debugger prefers "to turn vague intent into an identifiable need" and the Research Solutions Manager favours "supervising AI to make research programmes really move forward." 1. Advance judgement: whether the current AI process has resolved this stage of the problem. 2. Key gaps: what are missing, conflicting or insufficient evidence to influence further progress. 3. Next steps: The next round should do the most, giving, if necessary, a prompt that can be sent directly. 4. Current state: which can be considered valid for the time being and which cannot still be relied upon.
